Director of Sales – Nursing Education

UWorld is seeking a high-impact Director of Sales to lead and grow our Nursing Education sales organization across the Western United States. This is a full-time sales leadership and coaching position responsible for managing, developing, and motivating a team of Nursing Account Executives while driving consistent revenue growth across the region.

The Director will serve as a strategic leader for the Western region, partnering closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Product, and other cross-functional teams to expand UWorld's presence within nursing programs and institutions.

We are looking for a dedicated sales leader who thrives on developing people, driving accountability, building strong sales processes, and creating a high-performance culture.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of leading B2B sales teams, preferably within nursing education, healthcare education, EdTech, educational publishing, or a related industry, and understands how to sell solutions that improve student outcomes and help nursing programs prepare students for high-stakes licensure examinations.

What You'll Own

Regional Revenue Growth

  • Lead the sales strategy and revenue performance for UWorld's Nursing Education business across the Western United States.
  • Develop and execute regional sales strategies designed to achieve and exceed revenue targets.
  • Drive new institutional business across nursing schools, colleges, universities, and other healthcare education organizations.
  • Develop strategies to expand UWorld's footprint within existing nursing programs and institutional partners.
  • Identify market opportunities, emerging trends, and areas for growth throughout the Western region.
  • Establish a predictable, scalable pipeline aligned with nursing program purchasing cycles and academic calendars.
  • Partner with senior sales leadership to develop regional goals, forecasts, and growth plans.

Sales Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Nursing Account Executives across the Western United States.
  • Establish clear expectations around revenue performance, pipeline generation, activity, customer engagement, and professional development.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, pipeline reviews, forecast meetings, and performance discussions.

Nursing Education Market Development

  • 8–12+ years of B2B sales experience, with at least 5 years of successful sales leadership experience.
  • Proven success managing and developing high-performing sales teams.
  • Experience selling into nursing education, higher education, healthcare education, EdTech, educational publishing, SaaS, or a related industry.

  • Strong understanding of complex, multi-stakeholder B2B sales cycles.

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

jobs.description:
Who are we?
Hi! 👋 We are Ravelin! We're a fraud detection company using advanced machine learning and network analysis technology to solve big problems. Our goal is to make online transactions safer and help our clients feel confident serving their customers.
And we have fun in the meantime! We are a friendly bunch and pride ourselves in having a strong culture and adhering to our values of empathy, ambition, unity and integrity. We really value work/life balance and we embrace a flat hierarchy structure company-wide. Join us and you’ll learn fast about cutting-edge tech and work with some of the brightest and nicest people around - check out our Glassdoor reviews.
If this sounds like your cup of tea, we would love to hear from you! For more information check out our blog to see if you would like to help us prevent crime and protect the world's biggest online businesses.
The Team

You will be joining the Detection team, a team of machine learning engineers and data scientists. The Detection team is responsible for keeping fraud rates low by continuously training and deploying machine learning models. We aim to make model deployments as easy and error-free as code deployments. Google’s Best Practices for ML Engineering is our bible.

Our models are trained to spot multiple types of fraud, using a variety of data sources and techniques in real time. The prediction pipelines are under strict SLAs; every prediction must be returned in under 300ms. When models are not performing as expected, it’s down to the Detection team to investigate why.

The Detection team is core to Ravelin’s success. They work in a deeply collaborative partnership with the Data Engineering team to design the data architecture and infrastructure that powers our ML systems.

The Role

We are currently looking for an Engineering Manager to line manage ML engineers and drive innovation across our suite of fraud detection products. You’ll work closely with data scientists, product, engineering and our operations teams to develop ML models and ML products. Our ideal candidate is pragmatic, approachable and filled with knowledge tempered by past failures.
You will hire, coach and develop a talented machine learning team to deliver on the ML product and platform roadmap. You are in your element working with people. You’ll partner closely with senior members of Detection to discover new avenues for ML product innovation. From time to time, you’re excited to even do some software or model development yourself.

The work is not all green field research. The everyday work is about making safe incremental progress towards better models for our clients. The ideal candidate is willing to get involved in both aspects of the job – and understand why both are important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a key leader in establishing excellence within machine learning engineering and across the detection team
  • Line manage a team of machine learning engineers - providing coaching and guidance in support of the ongoing development and growth of your team
  • Propose and champion new machine learning methods and tools (including platforms that empower Data Science experimentation) to influence the technical roadmap and promote continuous innovation
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives with Data Engineering, Infra, and other teams to align on data architecture and ensure we make the right ML product decisions
  • Investigate model performance issues
  • Develop and deploy new models to detect fraud whilst maintaining SLAs

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience as an engineering manager, managing at least 3 people
  • You are a strong collaborator with colleagues outside of your immediate team, for example with data science, engineering, product, client operations teams and with senior leadership
  • You know how to manage and retain talented engineers from a diverse range of backgrounds and personalities. You can handle difficult management situations with tact, empathy and support
  • You have significant experience building and deploying ML models using the Python data stack
  • Familiarity with modern workflow orchestration tools such as Prefect, Kubeflow, Argo, etc.
  • You understand software engineering best practices (version control, unit tests, code reviews, CI/CD) and how they apply to machine learning engineering
  • Comfortable spending 30-40% of your time hands-on in the codebase and adapting your technical involvement based on the roadmap

Nice to haves
  • Pytorch or Tensorflow deep learning experience
  • Experience with Go, C++, Java or another systems language
  • Experience using dbt

Benefits

  • Flexible Working Hours & Remote-First Environment — Work when and where you’re most productive, with flexibility and support.
  • Comprehensive BUPA Health Insurance — Stay covered with top-tier medical care for your peace of mind.
  • £1,000 Annual Wellness and Learning Budget — Prioritise your health, well-being and learning needs with funds for fitness, mental health, and more.
  • Monthly Wellbeing and Learning Day — Take every last Friday of the month off to recharge or learn something new, up to you.
  • 25 Days Holiday + Bank Holidays + 1 Extra Cultural Day — Enjoy generous time off to rest, travel, or celebrate what matters to you.
  • Mental Health Support via Spill — Access professional mental health services when you need them.
  • Aviva Pension Scheme — Plan for the future with our pension program.
  • Ravelin Gives Back — Join monthly charitable donations and volunteer opportunities to make a positive impact.
  • Fortnightly Randomised Team Lunches — Connect with teammates from across the company over in person or remote lunches every other week, on us!
  • Cycle-to-Work Scheme — Save on commuting costs while staying active.
  • BorrowMyDoggy Access — Love dogs? Spend time with a furry friend through this unique perk.
  • Weekly Board Game Nights & Social Budget — Unwind with weekly board games or plan your own socials, supported by a company budget.

*Job offers may be withdrawn if candidates do not meet our pre-employment checks: unspent criminal convictions, employment verification, and right to work.​*

jobs.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

jobs.excerpt: Le français suit NATIONAL BOARD OF TRUSTEES (2 VOLUNTEER POSITIONS) POSITION TYPE: Volunteer.
jobs.description:
Le français suit

NATIONAL BOARD OF TRUSTEES (2 VOLUNTEER POSITIONS)

POSITION TYPE: Volunteer. Estimated commitment of approximately 4-8 hours per month, including meeting preparation and committee participation.

LOCATION: Flexible, Canada (Primarily remote with 1-2 in-person meetings annually).

POSTING DATE: March 18, 2026

DEADLINE: Open until positions are filled

START DATE: September 2026

The Organization

Canadian Parks and Wilderness Society (CPAWS) is Canada’s only national charity dedicated to protecting public land, freshwater and ocean, with a strong presence across the country. For more than 60 years, CPAWS has been a trusted leader in conservation — grounded in science, advocacy, local knowledge and collaboration — working to address the dual crises of biodiversity loss and climate change.

CPAWS advances the long-term protection of ecologically and culturally significant landscapes and waters, in ways that respect the sovereignty and leadership of Indigenous Nations. We achieve our mission through evidence-based advocacy, public engagement and strong partnerships.

Our vision is bold: permanently protect at least half of Canada’s land, freshwater and ocean to sustain nature and people for generations to come.

Operating on the unceded and unsurrendered lands of the Anishinabe Algonquin Nation, CPAWS works across treaty and unceded territories nationwide. We are committed to justice, equity, diversity and inclusion, and to fostering a safe and welcoming environment for people from diverse backgrounds.

The Role

CPAWS’ National Board of Trustees provides strategic governance oversight rather than operational management. Day-to-day leadership is the responsibility of the National Executive Director and staff. The Board works in partnership with this national team to:

  • Set long-term strategic direction
  • Ensure fiduciary oversight and financial sustainability
  • Monitor organizational performance and risk
  • Oversee and evaluate the National Executive Director
  • Ensure legal, ethical, and policy compliance
  • Safeguard mission alignment and long-term impact

The Opportunity

CPAWS is seeking two new Trustees with the following profiles to join its National Board:

Senior Executive Leader

A current or former CEO, President, Executive Director, or C-suite executive who has led a large, complex, multi-regional or national organization.

Ideal experience includes:

  • Leading growth, transformation, or strategic renewal
  • Oversight of multi-million dollar budgets and enterprise risk
  • Strong board–management partnership experience
  • Public policy, government relations, and/or national stakeholder engagement

Senior Fundraising / Development Leader

A senior development executive with demonstrated success in relationship-building with major donors, foundations and corporate partners.

Ideal experience includes:

  • Major gifts and donor strategy
  • Campaign leadership (capital, endowment, or comprehensive campaigns)
  • Corporate and foundation partnerships
  • Revenue diversification and philanthropic growth strategy (building capacity on the board)
  • Engaging boards in fundraising

Core Assets for Both Positions

  • Commitment to CPAWS’ mission and conservation outcomes
  • Governance experience (non-profit or corporate board experience preferred)
  • Strategic thinking and sound judgment
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
  • Commitment to diversity and Indigenous reconciliation

Application Submission

We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, including applicants from diverse cultures, racialized communities, abilities, sexual orientations, gender identities and expressions, and others who contribute to equitable representation and diverse perspectives.

We are committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment process. Please contact if you require accommodation at any stage.

Please apply submitting a cover letter and résumé combined into a single PDF titled: “LAST NAME_Board of Trustees”.

We thank all candidates for their interest. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

CONSEIL D’ADMINISTRATION NATIONAL (2 POSTES DE BÉNÉVOLAT )

TYPE DE POSTE : Bénévole. Engagement d’environ 4 à 8 heures par mois, y compris la préparation des réunions et la participation aux comités.

LIEU : Flexible, Canada (principalement à distance avec 1 à 2 réunions en présentiel par an).

DATE DE PUBLICATION : 18 mars 2026

DATE LIMITE : jusqu’à ce que les postes soient pourvus

DATE DE DÉBUT : Septembre 2026

L’organisation

La Société pour la nature et les parcs du Canada (SNAP CANADA) est le seul organisme caritatif national du Canada dédié à la protection de nos terres publiques, de nos eaux douces et de nos océans, en mettant à profit sa forte présence à travers le pays. Depuis plus de 60 ans, la SNAP CANADA est un chef de file reconnu dans le domaine de la conservation. Notre travail axé sur la science, la sensibilisation, les connaissances locales et la collaboration cherche à contrer la double crise de la perte de biodiversité et du changement climatique.

La SNAP CANADA œuvre à la protection à long terme des terres et des eaux d’importance écologique et culturelle. En travaillant dans le respect de la souveraineté et du leadership des Nations autochtones, nous accomplissons notre mission grâce à un plaidoyer fondé sur des données probantes, à la mobilisation du public et à des partenariats solides.

Notre vision est ambitieuse : protéger de façon permanente au moins la moitié des terres, des eaux douces et des océans du Canada afin d’assurer la survie de la nature et des être humains pour les générations à venir.

Établie sur les terres non cédées et non abandonnées de la Nation algonquine Anishinabe, la SNAP CANADA travaille sur les territoires visés par des traités et non cédés à l’échelle nationale. Nous sommes engagés en faveur de la justice, de l’équité, de la diversité et de l’inclusion, et nous nous efforçons de créer un environnement sûr et accueillant pour les personnes issues de divers horizons.

Le rôle

Le conseil d’administration national de la SNAP CANADA assure la supervision stratégique plutôt que la gestion opérationnelle. La direction des activités quotidiennes relève de la responsabilité du/de la directeur·ice général·e national·e et du personnel. Le conseil d’administration travaille en partenariat avec cette équipe nationale pour :

  • Établir l’orientation stratégique à long terme
  • Assurer la supervision fiduciaire et la viabilité financière
  • Surveiller la performance et les risques de l’organisation
    • Superviser et évaluer le·a directeur·ice général·e national·e
  • Garantir la conformité juridique, éthique et réglementaire
  • Garantir l’alignement sur la mission et l’impact à long terme

L’opportunité

La SNAP CANADA cherche à recruter deux nouvelles personnes présentant les profils suivants pour siéger à son conseil d’administration national:

Cadre supérieur

Une personne qui occupe ou a occupé un poste de PDG, de président, de directeur général ou de cadre supérieur au sein d’une grande organisation complexe et de portée multirégionale ou nationale.

L’expérience idéale comprend :

  • La conduite de projets de croissance, de transformation ou de réorientation stratégique
  • La supervision de budgets de plusieurs millions de dollars et la gestion des risques d’entreprise
  • Une solide expérience en matière de collaboration entre le conseil d’administration et la direction
  • Les politiques publiques, les relations gouvernementales et/ou la mobilisation des parties prenantes au niveau national

Responsable principal de la collecte de fonds/du développement

Une personne qui occupe ou a occupé un poste de cadre supérieur en développement et qui a fait ses preuves dans l’établissement de relations avec d’importants donateurs, des fondations et des entreprises partenaires.

L’expérience idéale comprend :

  • La stratégie en matière de dons majeurs et de relations avec les donateurs
  • La direction de campagnes (campagnes de capitalisation, de dotation ou globales)
  • La gestion de partenariats avec les entreprises et les fondations
  • La stratégie en matière de diversification des revenus et de croissance philanthropique (renforcement des capacités au sein du conseil d’administration)
  • La participation des conseils d’administration dans la collecte de fonds

Compétences essentielles pour les deux postes

  • Adhésion à la mission de la SNAP CANADA et à ses objectifs de conservation
  • Expérience en matière de gouvernance (idéalement au sein d’un conseil d’administration d’une organisation à but non lucratif ou d’une entreprise)
  • Réflexion stratégique et bon jugement
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en établissement de relations
  • Engagement envers la diversité et la réconciliation avec les peuples autochtones

Soumission des candidatures

Nous encourageons toutes les personnes qualifiées à postuler, indépendamment de leur origine culturelle, de leur appartenance à une communauté racialisée, de leurs capacités physiques, de leur orientations sexuelle, de leur identité ou expression de genre, ainsi que toute autre personne susceptible de contribuer à une représentation équitable et à la diversité des perspectives.

Nous nous engageons à mettre en place un processus de recrutement inclusif et sans obstacle. Veuillez contacter si vous avez besoin d’aménagements à n’importe quelle étape.

Veuillez postuler en joignant une lettre de motivation et un CV regroupés dans un seul fichier PDF intitulé : « NOM DE FAMILLE_Conseil d’administration »

Nous remercions toutes les personnes qui auront soumis une candidature. Seules les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien seront contactées. Les candidatures seront examinées au fur et à mesure.

Salary: Volunteer role / Bénévolat.

Position Title:

This position is a subject matter expert in global medical device and quality system regulations and is responsible for regulatory strategy and planning, authoring and submitting regulatory applications, assessing product design, manufacturing, labeling and quality system changes, authoring change impact assessments, and ensuring product labeling documentation, labels, promotional material, and product claims are accurate and compliant with global regulations. The Specialist will ensure adherence to company policy and procedures and will assist in maintaining quality control processes. This position will help the organization maximize the number of patients served while maintaining a high level of quality and safety through the support of the business functions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides regulatory support to product development and business teams including preparation of regulatory opinion documents, coordination of labeling activities, and review/approval of design control documentation, risk management reports, technical protocols/reports, clinical documentation and other outputs of product development.
  • Prepares/writes, submits, and manages global regulatory applications (including MDSAP markets, EU, and UK) as well as internal regulatory file documentation. Supports distributors and business partners in securing and maintaining regulatory clearances.
  • Maintains systems for tracking current projects and for projection of future activity loads.
  • Acts as company representative, developing and maintaining positive relationships with global regulatory agencies and business partners through oral and written communications.
  • Works professionally and cooperatively with cross-functional teams such as research and development, operations, quality, microbiology, packaging, medical affairs, and clinical affairs to ensure project success.
  • Assesses product design, labeling, quality system, manufacturing, and material changes for regulatory impact. Communicates changes effectively throughout the organization. Authors key portions of company responses to proposed standards, directives, policies and legislation regarding company products and systems.
  • Develops, processes, and maintains assigned departmental procedures, work instructions, and forms, and facilities training. Reviews and supports creation/updates of labeling procedures.
  • Supports the design, development, review, and approval of product labels, label items, advertising/promotional materials and product claims to assure accuracy, consistency and compliance to global regulatory requirements, as well as company and customer requirements. This includes verification of labels and advertising/promotional materials, and creation, verification, review, and processing of instructions for use.
  • Monitors and assesses changes to global regulatory regulations, directives, standards and guidance requirements (regulatory intelligence assessment). Manage project teams for completion of required activities to ensure compliance.
  • Supports regulatory aspects of the quality system and product non-conformities and leads assigned corrective and preventive action activities.

jobs.excerpt: About PlootoPlooto is a Canada-born fintech company on a mission to give small and mid-sized businesses the financial power to succeed on their own terms.
jobs.description:
About Plooto

Plooto is a Canada-born fintech company on a mission to give small and mid-sized businesses the financial power to succeed on their own terms. We make payments secure, accurate, and stress-free so businesses and their accountants can spend less time in the books, confidently manage cash flow, and make smarter decisions every day. We're a team that builds with integrity, agility, and heart, and we're looking for customer-minded pros who share our passion to join us as we scale.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Strategic Finance Lead to embed with the teams that drive our business — GTM, Product, and others as we grow — and raise the quality of decisions across the company. This is a partnering seat, not a reporting one: you’ll be in the room when a decision is being framed, not summarizing it afterward.

You’ll own the financial models for the areas you support, end to end. Because you own them, you’re in the decision rather than downstream of it. When a metric moves, your job isn’t to report that it moved — it’s to explain why, say whether that’s good or bad, and recommend what to do about it. When your business partners are weighing a decision, you’re the person quantifying the return.

You won’t inherit a playbook. You’ll write one — defining how finance partners with the business as the function grows.

The bar we’re setting

Today, a conversation about CAC often ends at “CAC went to $X because spend changed.” That’s arithmetic. We want a partner who asks the next questions: why did spend move — was it a deliberate test? What was the hypothesis, and how did it perform? How do we know our experiments are working? Is this a healthy shift or an early warning?

That’s the difference between reporting numbers and driving decisions, and it’s the heart of this role. We have good visibility into top-line trends; what we want is the ability to go a level deeper, consistently. That takes persistence — following the signal and going to find the data rather than waiting for it.

What you’ll cover

Today this role partners most closely with GTM — subscriber forecasting — and Product, where you’ll forecast TPV and revenue by product line and payment rail. As we grow, that will likely extend to Payments Strategy, Risk, and Operations.

We’ll be straight with you: we haven’t fully defined what finance support for those teams looks like yet, and we don’t expect one person to cover everything at once. Part of this job is helping us decide where finance partnership earns the most — and saying so when something should wait.

Your models serve two audiences: the teams they’re built for, and the company plan they roll into. We want models shaped to how each part of the business actually works that still connect cleanly to the central budget — so we plan from one picture instead of reconciling siloed models before a board meeting.

Build the system, not just the model

We’re not planning to solve capacity by adding people. We’d rather solve it with infrastructure: SQL pulling live from Databricks into models that refresh themselves, analysis that’s reproducible instead of rebuilt each month, and AI in the workflow where it genuinely saves time. You should be the kind of person who, faced with a manual process, gets slightly irritated and fixes it.

Much of our forecasting runs on Excel today, supported by live pipelines from our data warehouse. We know we’ll need something more scalable — and we’re deliberately open about what that is, whether a dedicated FP&A tool, a rebuild that leans harder on automation, or a different architecture altogether. You’ll help us decide and build it.

The team, and where this goes

Strategic finance is three people: the Senior Director (your manager), a Senior Financial Analyst, and you. The analyst owns the core FP&A engine — the company model, actuals, month-end performance analysis, and investor reporting. You’ll own the function-level models that feed it. You’re peers with distinct focus areas, and the expectation is that the two halves knit into one operating plan rather than running in parallel. Over time we want you cross-trained enough to cover for each other.

This is a senior individual-contributor role today, with no direct reports. We closed a funding round two months ago and are investing in growth — but we’re deliberately scaling this team through better systems and AI leverage rather than headcount. If we do add analysts, this is the person who’d oversee them. We’re not promising a management track; we’re telling you it’s a live possibility, and that the route to it is making the function work better, not bigger.

You’ll work closely with the CFO, with exposure to the CEO, and your work will feed directly into what we take to our board and investors.

What good looks like in your first year

  • The models for your areas are rebuilt on clear drivers, with sensitivities and scenarios that leadership actually uses when making a call.
  • Finance is in product and GTM decisions early enough to shape them — not brought in to forecast something already decided.
  • We can trace what specific initiatives contribute against a base case, so “did that work?” has an answer.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own driver-based financial models for the business areas you support, built around how each team actually operates.
  • Embed with those teams — challenge assumptions, frame tradeoffs, and bring a return-on-investment lens to decisions before they’re made.
  • Explain the why behind the numbers — investigate what moved a metric, judge whether it’s good or bad, and turn that into a recommendation. Help teams get closer to their own KPIs and the data behind them.
  • Connect your models to the company plan so each area rolls cleanly into the central budget.
  • Build and maintain live data pipelines — write SQL against our data warehouse (Databricks) to keep models refreshing on live data rather than manual pulls.
  • Help modernize our planning infrastructure with the Senior Director — tooling, automation, or architecture.
  • Distill complex analysis into crisp stories for executive and board audiences.
  • Partner with the Senior Financial Analyst to keep forecasting, budgeting, and reporting coherent as Plooto scales.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in strategic finance, FP&A, or business analytics — ideally in fintech, SaaS or another recurring-revenue business.
  • Payments or transaction economics — take rate, transaction mix across rails, cost per transaction, and how volume converts to revenue. This is core to how Plooto makes money, and you’ll be modeling it.
  • SaaS metrics in practice — ARR, MRR, churn, CAC, payback, LTV — and the judgment to know when a movement matters.
  • Hands-on SQL against a warehouse (Databricks or similar) wired into Excel, building live-refresh workflows rather than static exports.
  • Advanced Excel and driver-based modeling, with the ability to rebuild as the business and your understanding change.
  • Comfort reasoning about cause, not just correlation — you can tell a deliberate test from a drift, ask what the hypothesis was, and judge whether a result is real.
  • Exceptional communication — you can make a complex analysis simple and persuasive for technical and non-technical audiences, and hold your own with business leaders.
  • A partnering instinct, and the judgment to prioritize. With fluid scope and a lot of inbound, you’ll need to decide what earns your time and say no clearly.
  • Using AI tools to automate analytical workflows and work faster.
  • Experience helping select or implement FP&A planning tooling.

Why Become a Plootonian?

If you're looking to make a meaningful impact, look no further. We're transforming the payments space in North America by delivering an unrivalled product experience to solve a real and pressing problem for SMBs.

The biggest reason small businesses fail is poor financial management and cash flow — and Plooto fixes that. We have strong product-market fit, a massive opportunity ahead, and the backing of experienced fintech leaders.

You'll join a team that cares deeply about customer impact, takes pride in our craft, and moves with urgency. We're just getting started — and you'll help shape the next chapter of our growth story.

Join Plooto and be part of a mission that matters.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Plooto is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can thrive. We know great teams are built through diverse thinking, and we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification listed.

Accommodation is available throughout the recruitment process in accordance with applicable accessibility legislation. If you require accommodation at any stage, please let us know—we’re happy to work with you.

This posting is for one available position. Compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, and overall alignment with the role.

Recognized globally as a Great Place to Work and the recipient of multiple partner excellence awards, BIG is built on collaboration, innovation, and delivering measurable business outcomes for enterprise clients. We are a team of experienced technology professionals who enjoy solving complex challenges, celebrating wins together, and helping customers modernize with confidence.

AN EXCITING OPPORTUNITY WITH BIG AND CONVENE AI

BIG is excited to be partnering with Convene AI, an AI-focused technology company developing innovative solutions that leverage artificial intelligence to solve real-world business challenges.

As part of this partnership, we are looking for talented professionals to join BIG and work directly on Convene AI projects and initiatives. You will initially be hired as an employee of Bits In Glass, while working closely with the Convene AI team and contributing to the development and growth of their AI solutions.

The role is expected to remain on BIG’s payroll for approximately 12–18 months, with the intention of transitioning to a permanent position directly with Convene AI following this period, subject to business requirements and transition arrangements.This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an emerging AI organization at an important stage of its growth, while benefiting from the support, culture, and established consulting expertise of Bits In Glass.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You are the tip of the spear. You own the client relationship, the scope, and the definition of done. You decide what gets built, what does not, and when to tell a client no. This is not an internal product management role and it is not a program management role. You will be embedded with an enterprise client, running discovery, converting messy business problems into AI requirements a pod can build against, and holding a weekly release cadence together while stakeholders change their minds. Because our contracts are fixed-fee and outcome-based, your scope discipline is directly connected to whether the engagement is profitable. That is real commercial responsibility and we will treat you

accordingly.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Run discovery: map the current process, quantify where the pain and the money are, and identify where an agent creates measurable value rather than novelty.
    • Convert business problems into AI requirements with acceptance criteria that can actually be tested, working with the AI Quality Engineer to make them measurable before build starts.
    • Own the outcome definition on outcome-based contracts: what "working"means, how it is measured, who signs off, and what happens if the threshold is missed.
    • Manage the client-provided domain expert: secure their time in writing up front, and escalate immediately when their availability slips. Weak domain SME support is the single most common cause of slipped go-lives in this model, and catching it early is your job.
    • Manage scope ruthlessly. Weekly releases only work if the backlog is disciplined and someone is willing to be unpopular.
    • Run the weekly cadence: demo to the client, capture feedback, re-prioritise, and keep the pod pointed at the highest value work.
  • Own stakeholder alignment across business, IT, security, procurement, and legal, and get security and procurement engaged in week one rather than week nine.
    • Partner with the client's change and adoption team so the system gets used, not just delivered.
    • Track and report delivery health: burn, risk register, decision log, and benefits realisation against the agreed outcome.
    • Surface commercial risk early. Scope creep, weak executive sponsorship, and integration surprises are margin erosion, and you are the early warning system.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 3–8 years in product ownership, delivery management, or client-facing consulting, including at least 2 years shipping software rather than only running programmes.
    • A track record delivering under fixed-price or outcome-based commercial terms, where scope discipline had financial consequences.
    • Fluency in agile delivery at a genuine weekly release cadence, not two-week ceremony.
    • Enough technical literacy to challenge an engineer's estimate and to understand why a retrieval pipeline is returning poor answers. You do not need to write code.
    • A working understanding of what LLM-based systems can and cannot reliably do, and the confidence to tell a client when their request is not feasible.
    • Executive presence. You will hold steering committees with client CIOs, COOs, and business unit heads.
    • Experience in at least one of insurance, financial services, healthcare, or a comparably regulated industry.
    • Excellent written communication. Ambiguity that survives your documentation becomes a defect later.
    • Legally entitled to work in Canada and willing to travel to client sites.

BONUS POINTS

  • Prior experience at a top-tier strategy consultancy, Big Four, or a specialist delivery boutique.
    • A background as a business analyst, engineer, or data professional before moving into product.
    • Familiarity with AI quality concepts: evaluation design, acceptance thresholds, and human-in-the-loop workflow design.
    • Experience running engagements alongside a separate change management partner.

• Bilingual English and French.

WHY JOIN CONVENEAI

  • You will own client outcomes, not status reports.
    • Four-person pods mean your decisions translate into shipped software within days.
    • Outcome-based commercial terms mean the work is judged on whether it created value, which is a more interesting standard to be held to.
    • You will work directly with senior operators who have led AI delivery at Fortune 500 scale.
    • Real influence over how ConveneAI's delivery model evolves as we scale from the first pods to many.

Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design

Build digital products and services 0-1

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT QUINCEQuince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo.
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Jewelry)

We are seeking an exceptional Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Jewelry) to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices, done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency (consumption,C&M excellence), harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where major T1 and T2 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners.

Success in this role means achieving product cost at or near should-costing, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement processes with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business, contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global sourcing strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Procurement Category Strategy: Define and execute the commercial roadmap and vendor distribution strategy for assigned categories to improve margins as Quince scales. Establish short- and long-term procurement targets aligned to business growth.
    • Consistently deliver exceptional product cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations, including Procurement.
    • Partner with the technology team to embed procurement capabilities and playbook into the Vendor Portal and Product Catalog tools.
    • Identify and deliver 700 bps product cost reductions over the next 12 months.
  • RFP Ownership & Execution: Structure and run competitive, end-to-end bidding processes to secure optimal cost and commercial terms with manufacturing partners. Own the full lifecycle from vendor identification through award.
    • Deliver immediate, best-in-class product cost savings through rigorous negotiation, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term category maturity and sustainable competitive advantage.
    • Build AI agent to help us run RFP systematically in 2026 with the capability to build scenario analyses.
  • Clean Sheet & Buy Plan Approvals: Create and utilize component-level “clean sheets” to drive pricing transparency; review, approve, and solution to optimum cost for all buy events within your categories.
    • Current mature / scale categories: Ensure scale / cleansheet costing with Finished GoodsManufacturers Negotiate upstream of Finished Goods to secure best pricing and availability of (inputs (e.g. fabrics, yarns, fibers, commodities, trims) New categories / new products
    • Lead Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin targetPartner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing)
    • Negotiate reasonable launch costing and set schedule (monthly, quarterly, at trigger points) to renegotiate for scale pricing as the business grows
    • Support merchandising team by providing scale costing targets (i.e. what cost is achievable at scale)
  • Upstream Sourcing: Partner directly with the Material Manager, Sourcing Teams and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions.
  • Value Creation: Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays.
    • e.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)?

Qualifications

Required:

  • 12-15 years of experience in global procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management in a consumer goods or retail environment
  • Proven track record running competitive RFP processes with international manufacturing partners
  • Hands-on experience building and leveraging clean sheets for cost negotiation
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort with data-driven decision making
  • Experience working cross-functionally with merchandising, materials, and production teams

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range
$164,000—$240,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market.

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.
  • Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.
  • Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.
  • Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools, including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms.
  • Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.
  • Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks, identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.
  • Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.
  • Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.
  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

Requirements

  • Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.
  • 2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience, ideally working directly with sales teams.
  • Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills — you can explain complex concepts simply, keep a group engaged, and adapt your communication style to different levels of experience.
  • Patience, empathy, and emotional maturity. You are comfortable working with struggling trainees, handling difficult conversations, receiving critical feedback, and resolving disagreements constructively.
  • Strong ownership and accountability. You can recognize when something is not working, admit mistakes, review the situation objectively, and adjust your approach rather than becoming defensive or blaming others.
  • Energy and charisma to motivate people, maintain engagement, and create a positive but demanding learning environment.
  • Comfort with digital tools and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including CRM, telephony, messaging, presentation, and online training tools.
  • Ability to work remotely with stable internet connectivity and availability aligned with Colombia working hours.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in B2C sales, especially high-ticket, consultative, or fast-paced sales where discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing happen directly with the customer.
  • Previous experience as a Sales Trainer, Sales Coach, Team Lead, Supervisor, or Sales Manager.
  • Experience coaching or developing underperforming salespeople and helping them improve through practice, feedback, and structured follow-up.
  • Experience working in high-volume sales environments, including call centers or similar teams.
  • Experience creating or maintaining training materials, scripts, presentations, onboarding guides, or process documentation.
  • Experience using AI and modern productivity tools to create or improve training content, scripts, exercises, presentations, or documentation.
  • Experience working with LATAM-based sales teams serving the US market.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 1000-2000 USD Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

Role Description

As a Data Engineer on Analytics Data Engineering, you will build and operate the pipelines and data models the rest of Dropbox relies on to understand its products and its business. You will own well-scoped pipelines end to end — design, build, test, ship, monitor — with senior engineers alongside you for the harder architectural calls. Your work feeds the datamarts and KPIs used by data science, product, and company leadership, so the quality of what you build is visible quickly. This is a build-oriented team on a modern stack rather than a maintenance role, and a strong place to develop into an engineer who can own a full data domain.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Spark and SparkSQL jobs that populate company data models
  • Own well-scoped pipelines end to end, from requirements through deployment, monitoring, and iteration
  • Contribute to data quality frameworks, testing, and data lineage instrumentation
  • Partner with data scientists, analysts, product managers, and engineers to turn data needs into durable models
  • Extend datamarts and data models supporting recurring reporting and analysis across products
  • Improve the reliability and cost efficiency of existing pipelines, dashboards, and frameworks
  • Participate in a business-hours on-call rotation and help improve runbooks and alerting

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of development experience in Spark, Python, Java, C++, or Scala
  • 2+ years of SQL experience, including query performance tuning
  • 2+ years of experience with schema design and dimensional data modeling
  • Experience building and maintaining production data pipelines that others depend on
  • Working exposure to a cloud data lake or lakehouse platform, Databricks preferred
  • Clear written and verbal communication with non-engineering partners, and a track record of asking for help and feedback early
  • BS in Computer Science or a related technical field involving coding(e.g. physics or mathematics), or equivalent technical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with medallion architectures and incremental data modeling patterns

jobs.description:
At InStride, people are our purpose.

We believe that investing in people is the most powerful way to drive success—for individuals and organizations alike.

As a public benefit corporation, we partner with leading employers to unlock opportunities for their employees, providing access to top-tier education programs that align with their employees’ career goals and the company’s business goals.

Our mission goes beyond skill-building; we're here to empower our partners’ employees to advance their careers, elevate their expertise, and achieve meaningful personal and professional growth.

No matter the team you’re on, our dedication to the success of our partners and their employees is what drives us. If you're passionate about making a difference and driving educational and professional advancement, InStride is the place for you.

To get a better feel for our culture, watch more here.

Candidates must be located in one of the following states to be considered eligible for employment: AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, LA, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, TX, VA, WA, WI.

What we’re looking for InStride is looking for a Senior Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) to join a high-performing FP&A practice (processes, software tools, etc.) that can scale with our emerging, high growth company. This role will perform analysis and prepare reports to support the annual budget process, contribute to financial and operational close and reporting processes, and assist in putting together the financial forecast.

The ideal candidate will be able to partner with leaders and team members to provide financial / analytical guidance and influence key decisions that enable the company to achieve its core mission and improve enterprise value. This candidate will be a dynamic individual who can objectively research and analyze sophisticated issues and present recommendations in a clear and simple way to elicit support from other team members.

This is a hands-on seat on a small team. You will own recurring deliverables end to end - the model, the tie-out, the commentary and the slide - for audiences that include our executive team, our board, our sponsor and our lenders.

Skills we’d love to see you show off

  • Financial Analysis: Expertise in modeling, variance analysis, and budgeting to drive informed decisions.
  • Collaborative Problem-Solving: Skilled in partnering across teams to shape strategy and drive business results.
  • Systems Proficiency: Experienced with tools like NetSuite, Cube and Tableau, focusing on automation and process improvement.
  • AI Fluency: Comfortable using AI tools to move faster on analysis, drafting and quality checks — and clear-eyed about where they help, where they don’t, and what still has to be verified by hand.
  • Presentation & Communication: Ability to translate complex data into clear insights for leaders and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: Instinct to tie numbers out across files and systems before they go to a CFO, a board or an auditor, and to flag a variance rather than quietly bridge it.
  • Curiosity & Learning: Passion for understanding trends and continuously developing skills.
  • Analytical Thinking: Capable of identifying problems and offering innovative growth solutions.
  • Adaptability: Thrive in fast-paced settings, managing priorities with a high standard of work.
  • Cultural Awareness: Strong in navigating diverse environments, fostering inclusion, and building relationships.

Who you are

  • You believe in the power of education to transform lives and are motivated by the impact we’re making. You share our values of inclusivity, authenticity, and commitment to social good.
  • You enjoy working closely with others and believe that the best solutions come from diverse perspectives. You’re eager to partner with colleagues from across the business, bringing financial insights that drive collective success.
  • You’re naturally curious and constantly seeking out new knowledge, whether it’s about market trends, financial systems, new AI tooling, or how to be a better teammate.
  • You are proactive and take initiative. You thrive in environments where things move quickly and priorities can shift, and you’re ready to adapt without missing a beat.
  • You are dependable in the unglamorous moments. When something lands late in the day or needs one more check before it goes out, you pick it up and close it out without being chased.
  • You understand that people are at the core of what we do. You can navigate different personality types and work styles with ease, creating a positive and psychologically safe environment for everyone.
  • You’re passionate about making a difference, not just for business but for society. You seek roles where your work can have a lasting impact, and you’re excited about being part of a mission-driven company.

EXPERIENCE WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • 4+ years of finance experience, preferably in a high-growth technology company or consulting firm
  • Prior experience working for a private-equity backed company, including the reporting cadence that comes with a sponsor and lenders
  • Proven track record of achievement and delivering impactful results
  • Strong background in financial analysis with strong problem-solving skills
  • Consistent track record to distill issues into simple, structured frameworks that can be clearly communicated to key leaders and partners inside and outside of the company
  • Experience partnering with leaders across sales, marketing, R&D, operations, etc.
  • A curiosity and aim to thoroughly analyze issues and to come forward with clear recommendations for moving forward
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with individuals at all levels of the organization
  • Proven ability in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the challenge
  • Experience working in key systems to help improve and automate the finance function (ERP, FP&A, Analytics, CRM, etc.)
  • Prior experience with NetSuite, Cube and Tableau is a plus
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in finance or analytical workflow is a plus — we care more about judgment in applying them than about any tool
  • Ability to collaborate across teams internally and with partners e.g. with universities, corporate clients and the team

How you will create impact

PLANNING & FORECASTING

  • Assist in updating the long-range financial forecast model and partner with other teams across the organization to ensure that the modeling assumptions are reasonable and current
  • Help drive the annual budgeting process for functional areas, maintaining the budget templates and scenarios that functional leaders build from
  • Own headcount and contractor cost forecasting - roster-level detail, burden rates and role-by-role phasing — and reconcile it back to the plan each cycle

CLOSE, REPORTING & AUDIT

  • Assist in the creation, consolidation and distribution of monthly reports and critical metrics to key partners
  • Support the monthly financial close process and the annual financial audit as required
  • Prepare the recurring YTD and full-year reporting packages requested by our external auditors, lenders and sponsor, and stand behind the tie-outs between the model, the general ledger and the reported figures
  • Perform detailed budget vs. actual variance reports to each functional leader within the organization and support in presenting/distributing

BUSINESS PARTNERING & DECISION SUPPORT

  • Build and manage relationships across the business and be the POC for analytical support for assigned teams
  • Build decks and presentations for executives, the board of directors, and partners/clients — including P&L commentary, revenue bridges and segment or KPI pages that hold up to line-by-line scrutiny
  • Provide decision support (return on investment, NPV, benchmarking, etc.) on company decisions (partnerships, customer contracts, M&A activities, etc.)
  • Analyze vendor, cloud and other significant spend categories, separating what scales with the business from what does not, and bring cost-efficiency opportunities forward

SYSTEMS, AUTOMATION & AI

  • Help research, select, implement, and refine processes and systems to optimize the efficiency and performance of the FP&A team
  • Work in our FP&A platform (Cube) and ERP (NetSuite) to maintain scenarios, data fetches and mappings, so the plan and the actuals stay connected without manual rebuilds
  • Put AI to work on the parts of the job that are repeatable — first-draft variance commentary, reconciliation checks, deck production, summarizing source documents — and apply judgment about where a human tie-out is still required before anything reaches an executive audience
  • Develop an understanding of the markets, customers, and products to provide more substantial financial and analytical support to the organization
  • Perform ad required hoc research, analysis, and reporting
