jobs.title: Senior Facilities Manager
jobs.excerpt: Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Senior Facilities Manager to join our team.
jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Senior Facilities Manager to join our team.

Position Description

Oklo is hiring a Senior Facilities Manager to lead facility operations across our offices, laboratories, warehouses, test facilities, and other non-reactor spaces. This is a hands-on role responsible for managing day-to-day facility needs, projects, vendors, and requests while establishing consistent company-wide practices.

The Senior Facilities Manager will maintain visibility across Oklo’s facilities, identify capacity and infrastructure needs, and coordinate expansions, moves, and new locations. This person will initially serve as the primary individual contributor, using vendors and local site contacts as appropriate and recommending additional support as the portfolio grows.

The Senior Facilities Manager owns Oklo’s facilities systems and supports physical material operations while coordinating with each function’s designated authority. The role focuses on non-reactor corporate and operational facilities and is separate from Aurora powerhouse development, design, and construction.

Specific responsibilities may include:

Facilities Portfolio Real Estate and Space Planning

  • Maintain an accurate portfolio of facility use, capacity, constraints, lease terms, costs, and planned changes.
  • Establish an intake and decision process for new space, expansions, moves, and facility modifications.
  • Translate business needs into facility plans and support site searches, due diligence, lease activity, landlord relationships, and facility exits with Legal and Finance.
  • Assess facilities options to meet Oklo needs in various geographies including but not limited to short vs long term leasing, use of options such as but not limited to WeWork vs other solutions, etc.

Facility Operations and Projects

  • Serve as the primary contact for facility needs and coordinate resolution through local teams, vendors, contractors, and landlords.
  • Support maintenance, repairs, utilities, inspections, service contracts, workplace needs, and other recurring operations.
  • Manage facility openings, moves, tenant improvements, and modifications with internal and external partners.
  • Coordinate insurance, IT, cybersecurity, Security, EHS, Quality, and operational requirements throughout each facility’s lifecycle.
  • Establish practical standards for preventive maintenance, emergency procedures, compliance, records, and service levels.

Business Management and Cross Functional Coordination

  • Own facilities processes, tools, records, standards, and performance measures.
  • Develop operating and capital plans and manage budgets, forecasts, contracts, vendors, and service providers.
  • Identify risks, recommend practical solutions, and manage approved actions through implementation.
  • Monitor workload and recommend additional staffing or local support when justified.

Receiving Storage and Logistics Support

  • Partner with Procurement, Engineering, and site teams to support receiving, storage, material handling, and shipping.
  • Coordinate with Quality, EHS, and Security on requirements for controlled, hazardous, sensitive, or high-value materials.
  • Help resolve facility issues affecting material flow, storage capacity, or on-site logistics.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in facilities, workplace operations, construction management, industrial operations, warehousing, logistics, or a related function.
  • Experience supporting a multi-site portfolio that includes laboratories, warehouses, test facilities, light industrial space, or advanced manufacturing.
  • Hands-on experience with facility operations, vendors, maintenance, moves, tenant improvements, leases, landlords, and service contracts.
  • Experience managing budgets, capital plans, forecasts, and facility or space decisions.
  • Ability to establish scalable practices, work across functions, communicate with executives, and operate effectively in changing conditions.
  • Ability and willingness to travel among Oklo facilities and prospective locations.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience in nuclear, aerospace, energy, advanced manufacturing, research laboratories, defense, semiconductor, or another regulated or technically complex industry.
  • Experience establishing a facilities or site-operations function in a growing organization.
  • Familiarity with facilities, work-order, inventory, warehouse-management, enterprise resource planning, or space-planning systems.
  • Experience supporting controlled materials or improving receiving, inventory, storage, handling, and shipping processes.
  • Relevant credentials in facilities, construction, project management, safety, or supply chain.

Competencies

We are looking for a Senior Facilities Manager who is:

  • A hands-on owner who can manage the full portfolio while solving practical site problems
  • A builder of simple systems and standards that can scale without creating unnecessary process.
  • Comfortable moving between facility strategy, lease and vendor discussions, project execution, and day-to-day operations.
  • Commercially astute and able to evaluate costs, negotiate agreements, and make sound recommendations.
  • Passionate about clean energy
  • An optimist at heart
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in a modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $140,000 - $180,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

Du hast ein gutes Gespür für KI, Software, Prozesse und Automationen – und Lust, in einem jungen, dynamischen Team wirklich etwas zu bewegen?
Dann komm zu uns und hilf dabei, unsere Unternehmensgruppe digital noch besser, effizienter und zukunftsfähiger aufzustellen.

Deine Aufgaben:

  1. KI im Alltag sinnvoll integrieren (ChatGPT, Claude usw.)

  2. unsere Programme und ggf. neue (SaaS Lösungen) im Alltag betreuen

  3. neue Softwarelösungen auswählen, einführen und strukturiert aufbauen

  4. Prozesse digitalisieren und vereinfachen

  5. Schnittstellen und Systeme miteinander verbinden

  6. Automationen für wiederkehrende Aufgaben entwickeln

  7. bei Unternehmensübernahmen neue Standorte, Teams, Systeme und Prozesse strukturiert in unsere bestehende Organisation integrieren

  8. Standards, Abläufe und digitale Strukturen gruppenweit mit aufbauen und vereinheitlichen

  9. Kollegen bei Tools, Fragen und Problemen unterstützen

  10. Fehler finden und Lösungen umsetzen

Die wichtigste Aufgabe: Das weitere Wachstum unserer Unternehmensgruppe digital, prozessseitig und operativ langfristig mitgestalten.

Was dich bei der Demeco Unternehmensgruppe erwartet:

✔️ Flexible Arbeitsmodelle: Ob Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: Wir gestalten die Rolle so, dass sie zu deiner Situation und zu unserem Bedarf passt.

✔️ Flexible Arbeitszeiten & hybrides Arbeiten: Du arbeitest mit einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Flexibilität und der Möglichkeit, Aufgaben je nach Thema auch hybrid umzusetzen.

✔️ Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du arbeitest nicht nur bestehende Abläufe ab, sondern kannst Prozesse mit aufbauen, verbessern und neue Standards mitsetzen.

✔️ Direkter Einfluss auf Wachstum und Struktur: Deine Arbeit hat sichtbaren Einfluss darauf, wie wir als Unternehmensgruppe effizienter, digitaler und skalierbarer wachsen.

✔️ Starke Zusammenarbeit im Team: Du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, in dem man sich gegenseitig unterstützt, offen kommuniziert und gemeinsam Lösungen voranbringt.

jobs.title: Senior Paid Social Manager
jobs.excerpt: Launch With Us - Senior Paid Social ManagerFunction: Paid Social | Meta & TikTok Advertising | Performance Marketing Responsibility: Drive profitable growth across a portfolio of DTC brands through strategic paid social leadership, client management, and mentoring Paid Social Managers.
jobs.description:
Launch With Us - Senior Paid Social Manager

Function: Paid Social | Meta & TikTok Advertising | Performance Marketing
Responsibility: Drive profitable growth across a portfolio of DTC brands through strategic paid social leadership, client management, and mentoring Paid Social Managers.
Reports to: Paid Social Lead
KPI’s: New Customer Growth, MER, Client Retention
Location: Remote First
Compensation: £45,000 to £55,000

Overview:

At Launch With Us, we manage £25M+ in annual paid media across Meta, Google & TikTok for brands including Lucky Saint, Fem Fuelz, Butter & Crust, Four Five and Pets Pureset, taking them from £2-3M in revenue through £8M, £9M, £10M and beyond.

Creative and media sit on one team at Launch With Us, not two agencies bolted together and coordinated after the fact. Performance Media, Performance Creative, Paid Search and Growth Strategy all report into the same room, which is why we're ranked the UK's number one Independent Meta Agency Group by Meta, and part of the wider Soar Group.

As part of one of the UK’s leading independent agency groups, we operate with speed, autonomy, and a high level of ownership. There’s no red tape- just fast decision-making and the ability to move quickly. We’re also deeply AI-forward in how we think and operate, constantly evolving how we drive performance and efficiency for our brands.

Our team has quickly grown to 20+ operators after 120% YoY growth for the past 2 years. We offer remote-first working with access to our London office based in Camden, where all agencies in the group live! Culture, training, and professional development are at the heart of who we are, offering you structured training and clear progression into higher seats across the agency.

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Paid Social Manager, you will own strategy and performance across a portfolio of DTC eCommerce brands. You will work directly with founders and senior stakeholders to identify growth opportunities, improve account performance, and drive client outcomes. You will also mentor Paid Social Managers & Media Buyers, helping raise execution standards across the business.

You deeply understand the core levers that drive eCommerce growth: offer, conversion, creative, and distribution. You know how to diagnose performance challenges quickly, uncover opportunities others miss, and confidently present solutions that founders and commercial leaders trust and act on.

Working closely with Media Buyers, Paid Social Managers, and Creative teams, you'll identify growth opportunities, remove performance bottlenecks, and ensure strategy translates into measurable commercial outcomes - with the agency's specialist creative, media and data resource sitting behind you rather than in front of you.

The Brands Behind this Role:

You will be trusted with a small number of high-growth eCommerce brands, not a long list managed at arm's length. For confidentiality, specific accounts are not named ahead of interview, but the following reflect the calibre and scale you will be operating at, drawn from our own case study portfolio:

  • A premium, couture-finish womenswear brand. Founder-led, product-first, built on a loyal existing customer base: the challenge was finding new customers profitably after a disappointing quarter, without diluting the premium positioning. Recent portfolio outcomes at this level: 69% net profit increase, 9x blended ROAS, spend scaled 148%.
  • A challenger eCommerce brand built from an established Amazon marketplace base. Proven product, proven logistics, no owned acquisition channel yet: the mandate was building a full DTC paid media engine from a standing start, against a 100% year-on-year growth target. Recent portfolio outcomes at this level: 135% revenue increase, 97% new customer revenue increase, 79% more new customer orders.
  • A seasonal, subscription-building home and lifestyle brand. Strong peak-trading performance, a new subscription product still finding its footing: the challenge was maximising Q4 without the business resetting every January. Recent portfolio outcomes at this level: 82% year-on-year growth, 101% increase in new customers, 130% increase in subscription revenue.

    This is the standard of outcome expected in this seat, and the standard you will be expected to own and repeat.

Requirements

Your Impact:

  • The growth forecast for every account in your portfolio is yours to set: the number each brand needs to hit, and the paid social plan built to reach it.
  • Diagnose the one constraint actually holding an account back, whether that is offer, creative, or the page traffic lands on, and fix that before anything else.
  • Build creative testing roadmaps that treat volume and iteration as a science, not a backlog, so accounts compound instead of plateauing.
  • Apply offer psychology and landing page testing as core levers, not afterthoughts: pricing, bundles, and page experience decide as much as the ad does.
  • Carry new customer growth, MER, and retention as commercial outcomes you are accountable for, not metrics passed upward for someone else to act on.
  • When account data points at a specific lever, act on it immediately rather than waiting for the next scheduled review.

Strategic Account Leadership

  • Take ownership of strategy and performance across a portfolio of DTC e-commerce brands, ensuring activity remains aligned with client objectives, commercial targets, and growth plans. You will be responsible for translating business goals into actionable paid social strategies that deliver measurable results.
  • Lead account planning by identifying opportunities to improve customer acquisition, increase efficiency, and scale profitable growth. You will regularly review account performance and proactively recommend new initiatives that support long-term success.
  • Develop and oversee testing roadmaps across audiences, creative, offers, landing pages, and campaign structures, ensuring accounts continue to evolve and improve over time.
  • Work closely with Growth Executives to ensure strategic recommendations are implemented effectively and that account activity remains aligned with wider business objectives.

Performance Analysis & Growth

  • Analyse performance across Meta, TikTok, Triple Whale, Shopify, and reporting platforms to identify trends, opportunities, and areas of concern. You will use data to make informed decisions and guide account strategy.
  • Monitor key growth metrics including ROAS, CAC, MER, NC-ROAS, and customer acquisition efficiency, ensuring accounts remain on track to achieve performance targets.
  • Identify underperforming areas quickly and develop recovery plans that address performance issues while maintaining client confidence.
  • Continuously seek opportunities to improve account performance through testing, optimisation, and strategic recommendations that contribute to sustainable growth.

Creative Performance Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Creative Strategists to ensure creative output is aligned with account objectives and informed by performance data.
  • Provide strategic feedback on messaging, hooks, formats, offers, and content themes, helping shape creative testing priorities and future campaigns.
  • Use consumer insights and campaign learnings to influence creative direction and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates and customer acquisition performance.
  • Stay ahead of platform trends, creative developments, and emerging opportunities across Meta and TikTok, ensuring clients benefit from innovative approaches.

Ai & Operational Efficiency

  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate research, ideation, analysis, and strategic thinking.
  • Leverage AI to streamline workflows, improve output quality, and increase operational efficiency.
  • Identify opportunities where AI can unlock faster insight discovery or better decision-making.
  • Stay ahead of emerging AI tools and workflows relevant to performance marketing and growth strategy.

Client Leadership:

  • Act as the primary day-to-day strategic contact for assigned clients, building strong relationships through trust, reliability, and consistent performance.
  • Lead performance reviews, planning sessions, and strategy discussions with confidence, helping clients understand both short-term results and long-term opportunities.
  • Present recommendations clearly and commercially, ensuring clients understand the rationale behind decisions and the impact on business growth.
  • Drive client retention by delivering exceptional service, maintaining strong communication, and consistently demonstrating value.

What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months):

  • During your first three months, you will become fully embedded within your client portfolio and establish yourself as a trusted strategic partner for both clients and internal teams.
  • You will develop a thorough understanding of client objectives, account performance, and growth opportunities, while confidently leading strategic discussions and performance reviews.

jobs.title: Quantitative Trading Analyst
jobs.excerpt: About QompylQompyl is an early-stage fintech startup building a no-code platform that enables users to create, backtest, analyze, and monitor trading strategies.
jobs.description:
About Qompyl

Qompyl is an early-stage fintech startup building a no-code platform that enables users to create, backtest, analyze, and monitor trading strategies.

Our mission is to make sophisticated quantitative trading tools more intuitive, visual, and accessible. We are developing a platform where accuracy, data integrity, and sound financial logic are essential to delivering a reliable and trustworthy user experience.

About the Role

We are looking for a Quantitative Trading Analyst to help research, build, test, and improve trading strategies, indicators, and quantitative trading functionality within Qompyl.

This is a hands-on and cross-functional role combining quantitative research, systematic trading, indicator and signal development, strategy analysis, product validation, and product collaboration.

We are specifically looking for someone with a mathematically and statistically driven approach to trading. The ideal candidate can take a market hypothesis or trading idea, translate it into measurable rules or signals, test it rigorously using historical data, and critically evaluate whether the resulting performance is statistically and financially meaningful.

You will work directly with Qompyl's indicators and strategy-building tools: researching and developing indicators and signals, validating their mathematical and financial logic, building and backtesting systematic strategies, analyzing performance and risk, and identifying opportunities to improve the platform.

You will also work closely with our product and trading teams to translate quantitative trading concepts into intuitive tools that traders can use without needing to code.

This is not a traditional software QA role or a purely discretionary trading role. We are looking for someone who combines financial-market knowledge with quantitative thinking, enjoys experimenting with data and models, and can contribute to an evolving trading product.

Core Responsibilities

Quantitative Research & Signal Development

  • Research quantitative trading ideas, signals, indicators, and market relationships.

  • Translate market hypotheses into measurable, testable quantitative rules.

  • Apply statistical and mathematical methods to evaluate signal quality and robustness.

  • Analyze relationships across prices, returns, volatility, volume, momentum, market regimes, and other relevant market variables.

  • Identify noise, overfitting, unstable relationships, and potential biases.

  • Evaluate whether observed patterns are economically and statistically meaningful.

  • Document research methodology, assumptions, findings, and limitations.

Indicator Creation & Validation

  • Research and create new trading indicators and quantitative signals for the Qompyl platform.

  • Define indicator logic, formulas, parameters, signals, and expected behavior.

  • Validate calculations and outputs for mathematical and financial correctness.

  • Test indicators across different assets, time periods, market regimes, and parameter configurations.

  • Identify edge cases, unstable behavior, misleading signals, or unintended relationships.

  • Collaborate with trading and product teams to improve Qompyl's indicator library.

  • Translate quantitative concepts into intuitive functionality within the Strategy Builder.

Systematic Strategy Development & Backtesting

  • Build and test systematic trading strategies using Qompyl and analytical tools such as Python.

  • Combine signals, indicators, market conditions, and risk rules to research different strategy hypotheses.

  • Analyze entries, exits, position sizing, portfolio allocation, returns, P&L, drawdowns, volatility, Sharpe ratio, and other relevant performance and risk metrics.

  • Design rigorous backtests and critically evaluate their results.

  • Account for potential issues such as overfitting, look-ahead bias, survivorship bias, transaction costs, slippage, and parameter sensitivity.

  • Perform out-of-sample, robustness, and scenario testing when appropriate.

  • Challenge results that appear statistically or financially unrealistic.

  • Compare strategy behavior across different assets and market regimes.

Product Collaboration

  • Work closely with Qompyl's product, engineering, data, and trading contributors.

  • Bring a quantitative trading perspective to new indicators, strategy-building functionality, analytics, and product features.

  • Help determine whether proposed quantitative features are mathematically sound and useful to traders.

  • Translate quantitative research into clear product requirements and user-friendly functionality.

  • Participate in brainstorming and exploration of new trading and research tools.

  • Help bridge the gap between quantitative research and an intuitive no-code trading experience.

Trader & Community Feedback

  • Engage with traders and beta users to understand how they build and evaluate strategies.

  • Gather feedback on indicators, strategy analytics, and quantitative functionality.

  • Identify recurring needs that could become new signals, indicators, analytics, educational resources, or product improvements.

  • Explain quantitative trading concepts clearly to users with different levels of technical expertise.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong quantitative foundation in mathematics, statistics, probability, econometrics, engineering, computer science, physics, quantitative finance, or a related discipline.

  • Hands-on experience with quantitative research, systematic trading, algorithmic trading, or quantitative strategy development.

  • Strong understanding of statistical analysis and its application to financial markets.

  • Experience researching and testing trading signals or systematic strategies.

  • Strong understanding of backtesting methodology and common sources of bias.

  • Ability to analyze strategy performance using risk and return metrics.

  • Proficiency with Python for quantitative analysis, research, or backtesting.

  • Strong practical understanding of financial markets and trading mechanics.

  • Understanding of entries, exits, order logic, position sizing, risk, P&L, returns, volatility, and drawdowns.

  • Ability to critically evaluate whether quantitative results are statistically and financially reasonable.

  • Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and healthy skepticism.

  • Ability to communicate quantitative concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical collaborators.

  • Comfortable working independently in a remote, asynchronous, early-stage startup environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree or advanced coursework in mathematics, statistics, quantitative finance, econometrics, engineering, physics, computer science, or another highly quantitative discipline.

  • Experience with NumPy, pandas, SciPy, statsmodels, scikit-learn, or similar quantitative/data-science libraries.

  • Experience with time-series analysis, statistical modeling, optimization, factor research, or machine learning applied to financial markets.

  • Experience creating or modifying trading indicators.

  • Familiarity with TradingView, Pine Script, or other strategy-building/backtesting platforms.

  • Experience working with stocks, ETFs, futures, forex, cryptocurrencies, or derivatives.

  • Experience with SQL and financial datasets.

  • Experience contributing to a fintech, trading, analytics, or investment product.

  • Product-oriented or entrepreneurial mindset.

  • Experience communicating quantitative research or trading concepts to broader audiences.

Working at Qompyl

You will work closely with Qompyl's product, engineering, data, and trading contributors to ensure the platform is quantitatively sound, financially accurate, technically reliable, and genuinely useful to traders.

This role requires curiosity, precision, ownership, and healthy skepticism. We are looking for someone who will question not only whether a strategy or indicator works technically, but why it appears to work, whether the result is statistically robust, and whether it is likely to remain meaningful outside the dataset in which it was developed.

You should be comfortable working independently, communicating asynchronously across time zones, taking ownership of quantitative investigations, and contributing beyond a narrowly defined function in an evolving startup environment.

💡 Please Note – Equity-Only Structure

This is a part-time role (approximately 12–15 hours per week), suitable as a side engagement alongside a primary job or consulting work.

The position is currently equity-only, with the goal of transitioning to a cash + equity structure as Qompyl reaches its funding, product, and revenue milestones.

If you're excited about joining an early-stage fintech and helping build a next-generation quantitative trading platform, we'd love to hear from you.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Full-Cycle Claims & Payment Processing

  • Review charges and claims for complete billing accuracy; validate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding.

4. Insurance Verification & Prior Authorizations

  • Identify services, procedures, and medications requiring prior authorization; compile and submit necessary documentation.
  • Track authorization requests, maintain current expiration dates in patient records, and handle auth-related appeal escalations (especially critical for weight-loss medications).

5. Administrative & Communication Support

  • Monitor incoming electronic faxes for payer determinations, authorization approvals, and claim correspondence; route and document all paperwork within eClinicalWorks.
  • Utilize our Telzio VOIP phone system to handle inbound and outbound billing calls with payers and patients.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 3+ years of hands-on, full-cycle U.S. medical billing and RCM experience.
  • Core Competencies: Extensive background in claim submissions, A/R follow-up, payment posting, complex denial/appeals workflows, patient collections, and eligibility/prior auths.
  • Coding Mastery: Strong proficiency with standard CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10 coding, and modifier usage.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English skills; comfortable calling insurance representatives and speaking with patients.
  • Compliance: Thorough understanding of HIPAA regulations, patient privacy laws, and medical records handling.

Preferred Qualifications (High Priority)

  • EMR: Recent, hands-on experience using eClinicalWorks (eCW)—you must be comfortable navigating eCW with minimal system-specific training.
  • Specialty Expertise: Billing experience in Internal Medicine, Pediatrics, or specialized Obesity Medicine / Weight Management / Nutrition practices.
  • Medication Auth Experience: Prior success securing approvals and managing denials for weight-management and chronic disease medications.
  • Software Tools: Familiarity with Telzio VOIP or similar softphone applications, along with digital fax management workflows.

Process & Systems

  • Content Investment Analysis: Build a financial framework for evaluating content spend ROI — linking content production costs to subscriber acquisition, engagement, and retention to help the content team prioritize where to invest
  • Product Squad Cost-to-Value Model: Work with the Head of Product to create a repeatable model that maps product squad expenses to business outcomes, enabling data-driven decisions about team structure and resource allocation
  • ChargeBee Deep Dive: Become the in-house expert on our billing platform — audit the current integration with the GL, document how subscription events (new, renewal, cancellation, chargeback) flow through revenue recognition, and build a troubleshooting guide for edge cases like prior-period adjustments

Requirements

  • A collaborative, confident communicator who thrives in a fully remote environment — you seek out cross-functional partnership rather than waiting for requests to come to you
  • CPA, CMA, or equivalent professional certification, direct experience with ChargeBee, and comfort leveraging AI tools for financial analysis are all strong pluses

Benefits

Why should you consider joining Auvik?

  • You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology. Auvik’s network management software helps IT teams by automating time-consuming tasks, streamlining operations, and mitigating risk. It’s more important than ever to be able to remotely monitor and manage network infrastructure, and with Auvik, IT professionals have that essential visibility and control.

  • You want regular opportunities for learning and growth. With ongoing feedback from leadership, you’ll find that Auvik encourages you to be your very best. Our onboarding process is thorough and informative because we want to make sure you’re prepared to have a great work experience. We also have programs designed to help you take the next steps you want for your career.
  • You want the flexibility to manage your work, your way. We’re a fully distributed team and we’re prepared to continue to support working from home (or the space you choose!). We trust you to get the job done where you feel most comfortable and effective.

What’s the job about?

As a Staff Software Developer at Auvik, you’ll lead through technical excellence. You’ll dive deep into our systems, tackle the hardest technical problems, and deliver production-quality solutions that improve our products and platform at scale. While your influence may extend across teams through shared tooling, mentorship, or technical guidance, your day-to-day focus will be deeply embedded in a development team — designing, coding, debugging, and shipping high-quality software alongside your teammates.

This role is ideal for a developer who wants to stay close to the codebase while still having wide-reaching technical influence and driving high-impact outcomes.

What will I be doing?

You’ll focus on:

  • Own complex technical challenges and architect scalable, performant solutions.
  • Writing clean, maintainable code — and lots of it — in languages like Go, Scala, or TypeScript (React/GraphQL).
  • Diagnosing and resolving complex production - digging across systems to find root causes and deliver lasting fixes that restore customer trust.
  • Working closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to build features that provide real value to our customers.
  • Apply AI-enabled techniques to solve complex engineering problems, using intelligent tooling, automation, and data-informed debugging to build scalable systems, improve reliability, and accelerate delivery across the stack.
  • Leading by example in code reviews, mentoring other developers, and championing best practices in development and testing.
  • Proactively identifying and implementing technical improvements across our codebase, systems, and developer workflows.
  • Collaborating across teams to ensure consistency in implementation, performance, and user experience.
  • Helping unblock others by sharing context, reviewing designs, and contributing reusable tools, libraries, or frameworks.

What are we looking for?

  • A hands-on engineer who loves solving tough problems through code and building systems that scale.
  • A deep technical contributor with a strong grasp of system design, clean coding practices, and debugging complex issues.
  • A team player who thrives in collaborative environments and can communicate ideas effectively across functions.
  • A mentor who lifts others by pairing, sharing insights, and providing thoughtful feedback in reviews.
  • A proactive self-starter who can independently lead projects from start to finish, always looking for ways to improve.
  • Familiarity with tools and practices for logging, tracing, metrics collection, and alerting (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Datadog, etc.).
  • You’ve tackled performance bottlenecks or scalability challenges in high-traffic systems.
  • You’ve built tooling or frameworks that boosted developer velocity.
  • You’ve contributed to open-source projects or enjoy staying sharp with side projects.
  • A deeply technical, hands-on engineer who uses AI pragmatically to solve hard problems, writes high-quality production code, debugs across distributed systems, and elevates team output through strong system design and engineering rigor.

Our Stack

  • Frontend: React (TypeScript), GraphQL
  • Backend: Go, Scala
  • Infrastructure & Data: Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS
    (… and more, depending on your area of focus)

We’re actively hiring for this role and looking to bring someone great onto the team as soon as possible.



About Auvik

Auvik delivers cloud-based network management software that gives IT teams instant visibility and control over their infrastructure — whether on-site, remote, or dispersed across global networks. Our platform automates network discovery, mapping, monitoring, configuration backups, traffic analysis and alerting, so IT professionals and MSPs can manage complex, multi-site environments with ease.

We’re focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to make any accommodations you may need throughout the interview process as well.

Auvik is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

Hiring Process

At Auvik, our hiring process is designed to be personal, transparent, and human-led. Our Talent Acquisition Partners review all resumes, connect with candidates whose skills and experience aligns with the role, and stay in communication with you throughout your journey. If our interests align, you'll meet with a hiring manager, as well as additional members of the hiring team in follow-up conversations. All of your interviews will take place via Zoom.

Before meeting with a hiring manager, we also ask candidates to complete a 5-minute Predictive Index (PI) assessment. This helps us understand and match your strengths and work preferences with roles that will set you up for success.

We use AI tools to support administrative tasks in the hiring process; such as helping source candidates, drafting communications, and interview summaries, so our team can stay focused and present during conversations. We do not use AI tools to interview, screen or assess candidates; or determine who moves forward in the process. We debrief and consider the full context of every conversation before making hiring decisions. We believe hiring requires judgment that can be augmented but, not replaced by AI.

Compensation Details

At Auvik, our compensation philosophy is to be market competitive, reward performance, reflect our commitment to equity and maintain transparency with our employees. We have defined job levels and compensation ranges for each of our markets we employ, based on research from various sources of market data, which are reviewed on a regular basis.

The hiring range for this position is listed below. Compensation offered for candidates in this role is based on a number of factors including job-related skills, knowledge, and experience. These factors may cause your compensation to vary within the range outlined below.

In addition to cash compensation, all full-time employees are granted stock options to share in Auvik’s future successes. Auvik employees are eligible to participate in additional benefits and programs including our comprehensive health and dental benefits plan, Wellness spending account, GRSP matching program, flexible paid time off, paid parental leave program, and are eligible for remote working subsidies.

jobs.title: Design Team Lead - Ecommerce Marketing Agency
jobs.excerpt: The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team.
jobs.description:
The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team. There are two sides to it. One is craft, which means keeping the standard of the design work high across every client we serve. The other is people, which means keeping the team organised, supported, and able to do good work without getting stuck.

Most of what the team produces is email and SMS campaign design for ecommerce brands, along with ad images, GIFs, short video edits, and the occasional landing page. You will still design yourself, but the larger part of the job is making sure what goes out is right. You are the person who spots what is not working in a design before the client does, and who explains the fix in a way a designer can act on straight away.

You will work closely with Account Managers, who assign the day to day tasks, and with the designers who carry them out. A good deal of the role sits between those two groups: helping an Account Manager work out what a campaign actually needs, turning that into clear direction for a designer, and saying so when a request does not make sense.

The Design Team Lead reports to the Service Director, and works closely with the other departments at Hustler Marketing to make sure design work is delivered well and on time.

About the Role:Mission statement:

To keep the quality of our design work at a level clients notice, and to run a team that is organised, well briefed, and heard.
The first half of that is craft. Reviewing work, spotting what is weak in a design, and giving direction that makes it better. The second half is people. Distributing the week, reorganising it when something changes, and making sure the team's ideas and concerns reach someone who can act on them. We already have a strong team here, independent and reliable. What they need from a lead is someone who listens properly and comes back with a real answer.


General Responsibilities:

Design quality and direction

  • Reviewing the team's design work before it reaches Account Managers or clients, and giving feedback specific enough to act on
  • Diagnosing why a design is not working, whether that is hierarchy, contrast, the weight of the call to action, the balance of image to text, or how it holds up on mobile, and writing the fix down clearly
  • Advising Account Managers on what a campaign needs visually, and pushing back when a brief is thin or a request will not serve the client
  • Designing directly when the workload calls for it. This is a hands-on role, not a purely supervisory one
  • Keeping the work consistent across a wide range of client brands, niches, and visual identities
  • Setting and holding the design standards for email and SMS campaigns, ad images, GIFs, and short video assets
  • Understanding each client's visual brand identity well enough to advise on ideas, improvements, and optimisations

Running the week

  • Distributing and organising the team's workload week by week, working from the tasks Account Managers assign
  • Reorganising the queue quickly when priorities change, someone is unavailable, or a client adds something at the last minute
  • Keeping track of who is overloaded and who is not, and rebalancing before it turns into a missed deadline
  • Being the first person the Design Team comes to when something is blocking their work
  • Making sure the design targets set for each client account are met

The team

  • Running the Design Team's group calls and regular one-to-ones
  • Collecting the team's suggestions and concerns, taking them seriously, and coming back with an answer, including when the answer is no
  • Mentoring designers and helping the less experienced members build their skills
  • Onboarding new designers into how we work
  • Connecting Design with the other service teams through workshops, short tutorials, and written documentation
  • Running training and skill-building sessions for the Design Team

Process and improvement

  • Noticing where a workflow, a handoff, or a piece of communication is costing the team time, and fixing it
  • Writing and maintaining the documentation the team works from
  • Keeping up with what Figma ships and bringing the useful parts into how the team works
  • Staying current on design and email marketing trends, and sharing what matters rather than everything
  • Bringing industry best practices back to the Service Director and to the team
  • Taking on projects and initiatives delegated by the Service Director


Position Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month, consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement, meaning you cannot hold a position of a similar nature elsewhere while working for Hustler Marketing
  • A 30-day notice period after the first month
  • Performance reviews every 9 to 12 months, with the first one after 3 to 6 months

Requirements

About you:

Profile:

You are a senior designer with at least five years behind you, and a portfolio of real client work across different brands and niches rather than a handful of personal projects. At least three of those years involve email marketing design.

You are expert in Figma. Not comfortable in it, expert. You should be able to build and maintain component libraries, and it helps if you follow what Figma releases closely enough to tell the team when something new is worth adopting. Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity is a useful complement, though we do not lean on either heavily.

You know more than one kind of design output. Email and SMS campaign design is the core of it, but ad images, GIFs, and short video edits come up constantly. Some basic knowledge of web design is a plus rather than a requirement, since landing pages appear from time to time and the team already handles most of that themselves.

What matters most is your eye, and how you talk about it. You can look at a design that is not performing and say what is wrong with it, in what order, and what you would change first. Then you can put that in a message a designer understands without needing a follow-up call. That skill is most of this job.

You are organised enough to run a week of work across several people, and to rearrange it at short notice without the whole thing falling apart.

You are the sort of person a team talks to. Ours is independent and reliable, and there are a few things they would like to see improved that are hard to change quickly. What matters to them is knowing their comments are being considered and answered, not that every one of them gets a yes.

You are curious. You notice when a process could be better and you do something about it instead of working around it. You bring people together across teams with workshops, documents, and tutorials without waiting to be asked.

And you notice detail, in your own work and in everyone else's.


Key traits for this position:

Strong visual judgement, and the vocabulary to explain it. Organised, and calm when the week changes shape. Approachable, and willing to have the honest conversation rather than the easy one. Curious about tools and trends without chasing every new thing. Detail-oriented past the point of comfort. At ease working remotely with people spread across several countries and time zones.


Key Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a graphic designer, with a minimum of 3 years in email marketing design
  • Expert-level Figma skills, including building and working from component libraries
  • Working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity
  • Experience producing ad images, animated GIFs, and short video edits
  • An established portfolio showing on-brand, effective design work for a range of clients, stores, and niches
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating other designers. A formal lead title is not required, but you should have done the work
  • The ability to review someone else's design work and give written feedback that is specific and actionable
  • The ability to distribute and reorganise a team's weekly workload, including at short notice
  • A basic understanding of web design and landing pages is a plus
  • Experience with Klaviyo, or with a comparable email marketing platform, is a plus
  • Comfortable with Slack, Asana, Hubstaff, Google Workspace, and Figma, and willing to learn whatever else we use
  • Fluent written and spoken English. It does not need to be your first language, but you will be writing feedback and running calls in it every day
  • Remote work experience, ideally with a team spread across time zones
  • Available and responsive during office hours, Monday to Friday between 3 and 6 PM Barcelona time
  • Consistently working 30 to 35 hours per week, which is 140 hours per month
  • A stable internet connection, a laptop or PC, and the ability to join video calls

TechOps Engineer - Mid Level

About the Role?

We're looking for a hands-on Mid-Level TechOps Engineer to join our fully remote team and help us build, automate, and maintain the infrastructure that powers contact center technology for B2B clients across the country. If you can own a CI/CD pipeline end-to-end, feel at home in a cloud console, and care about getting the details right - we want to talk.

What do we do?

ACD Direct, Inc. is an innovative, virtual company that thrives on brokering solutions for our non-profit clients. ACD’s heartbeat and competitive edge is powered by our people. Our company has grown from providing routine call center services to providing high-level, full-scale donor support resources and products. Our proprietary scripting engine, web forms and custom-built reporting enable clients to successfully conduct large-scale fundraising campaigns with accuracy and creativity. ACD is a B2B Contact Center Technology company building and operating the infrastructure that keeps modern contact centers running at scale. Our platform is cloud-native, security-first, and built by a fully distributed team spread across the United States. We move fast, document everything, and treat operational excellence as a core value - not an afterthought.

Limitations:

Applicant preferred to be located within a 50 mile radius of Salt Lake City, Utah. Although position is remote employee will be required to visit data center on a quarterly basis. It is not required for the employee to be located in the state of Utah.

What will you do?

  • Build, manage, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines for serverless and containerized applications with minimal supervision.
  • Automate deployment, configuration, scaling, and monitoring workflows using best-practice tooling.
  • Monitor infrastructure, applications, and services - investigate alerts, diagnose root causes, and resolve incidents independently.
  • Contribute to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management initiatives.
  • Participate in security reviews, vulnerability assessments, and PCI DSS compliance monitoring - including patching and audit log maintenance.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and QA teams to improve deployment velocity and release quality.
  • Help onboard and guide junior team members, sharing knowledge and best practices.
  • Maintain clear, accurate documentation for systems, runbooks, and operational processes.
  • Participate in Agile SDLC ceremonies and contribute to sprint-based delivery.

What You Bring

  • 1–4 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, TechOps, Systems Engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Solid experience with CI/CD tooling - GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or equivalent.
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP); familiar with core services like compute, networking, storage, and IAM.
  • Working knowledge of containerization (Docker) and basic orchestration concepts.
  • Experience with scripting or automation (Bash, Python, or similar).
  • Understanding of infrastructure-as-code principles; some hands-on experience with Terraform or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with security fundamentals - access controls, encryption, patching, and audit logging.
  • Strong written communication skills; you write documentation that teammates actually want to read.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, async-friendly environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting PCI DSS compliance requirements.
  • Exposure to Kubernetes or container orchestration platforms.
  • Familiarity with observability tooling (Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch, or similar).
  • Background in contact center, telecom, or SaaS infrastructure environments.
  • Experience with SMS platforms or telecommunications APIs.

Growth & Mentorship

This role sits squarely in the middle of our TechOps career ladder, with a clear path toward senior-level ownership. You'll be supported by senior engineers who are invested in your growth and expected to start passing that investment down to junior teammates. We prioritize people who are curious, communicative, and always looking to level up.

How we will support you?

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

jobs.title: Founding Head of GTM - Cipherscale
jobs.excerpt: The Opportunity: Zero-to-one category creation for AI-Native Zero Trust Access Cipherscale is building an AI-native Zero Trust access and enforcement plane for humans, software/workloads, and AI agents.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity: Zero-to-one category creation for AI-Native Zero Trust Access

Cipherscale is building an AI-native Zero Trust access and enforcement plane for humans, software/workloads, and AI agents.

The product doctrine is simple: AI may reason and propose; deterministic policy authorizes; trusted enforcement executes.

We are looking for a commercial founder/operator who can turn that architecture into a category, a repeatable customer problem, real deployments, and initial revenue.

Mission: discover and prove the repeatable commercial truth for Cipherscale - who urgently needs it, what gets them to deploy, what makes them pay, and what causes them to expand.

What You Own

• Own ICP discovery, exclusion criteria, buyer/champion mapping, problem validation, positioning, initial wedge, and design-partner recruitment.

• Personally lead early customer discovery, technical/commercial conversations, executive outreach, design-partner conversion, and initial closing.

• Build an evidence-driven GTM system: every important assumption has supporting/contradicting evidence and a next falsification test.

• Use AI agents aggressively for research, account intelligence, personalization, competitive monitoring, meeting preparation, call synthesis, content, and experiment analysis.

• Work directly with the CEO on category creation and major strategic accounts.

• Work with Product and Engineering to convert recurring customer evidence into governed product inputs - without turning prospect anecdotes into roadmap commitments.

• Define the first repeatable acquisition, deployment, conversion, and expansion motion before scaling a team.

What This Role Is Not

• It is not a traditional marketing leadership job.

• It is not an MQL, impressions, content-calendar, or brand-campaign role.

• It is not a decision to hire SDR, demand-gen, content, and marketing-ops teams before product-market evidence exists.

• It is not ownership of OpenVPN growth. Rod, Head of Growth, owns the established-business growth mandate;

This role is focused on Cipherscale zero-to-one GTM and must collaborate cleanly without duplicating authority.

Important:

  • This is a full-time remote job, and it will be a long-termB2B contract.

  • This can be a permanent employment opportunity for candidates based in Spain, Poland, and Germany.

Our philosophy is that we are a small, close-knit team, and we care deeply about you:

  • Highly competitive salary + Bonus

  • Fully remote work environments.

  • Self-managed time off.

Requirements

Who We Want

• You have personally helped take a deeply technical B2B security, infrastructure, identity, developer, cloud, or AI

product from near-zero to repeatable initial revenue.

• You can sit with a CISO, CTO, security architect, platform engineer, and AI-platform leader and earn credibility.

• You understand enough security architecture to reason about identity, delegated authority, credentials, policy,

enforcement, trust boundaries, auditability, and blast radius.

• You are comfortable selling before there is a polished playbook and learning directly from rejection.

• You treat AI as operating leverage. Your instinct is to build agentic workflows before asking for headcount.

• You are analytical enough to distinguish activity from evidence and evidence from causality.

• You are comfortable challenging the CEO and product assumptions when customer evidence disagrees.

Strong Background Signals

• Early-stage Zero Trust, identity, cloud security, developer security, infrastructure security, AI security, developer infrastructure, or adjacent enterprise-security categories.

• Founder, first-GTM, product-led commercial operator, technical seller, or hands-on GTM executive backgrounds can all fit.

• Large-company titles alone are not compelling.

Anti-Profile

• Your first answer to a growth problem is "hire a team."

• You depend on agencies for core positioning or customer discovery.

• You optimize lead volume before proving deployment and retention.

• You cannot personally run technical discovery or executive selling.

• You treat AI as a copywriting assistant rather than an operating system.

• You blur probabilistic AI recommendations with authorization or security enforcement.

First 90 Days: Window Expected outcome

• 0-30 days: 10-15 qualified ICP conversations; ~5 credible design-partner candidates; evidence-backed recommendation on ICP, problem, buyer, positioning, and wedge.

• 31-60 days: Convert the strongest partners into real or production-like deployments; measure time-to-value, blockers, security objections, and willingness to pay.

• 61-90 days: Target 5+ production or production-intent deployments where product readiness permits; first paying customers; prove or disprove repeatability with a second cohort; document the acquisition/onboarding motion.

How Success Is Measured

• Business: paid customers, initial ARR/MRR, expansion and eventually defensible unit economics.

• Customer: time-to-first-value, production activation, repeated authorized usage, protected resources/principals,

retention and expansion.

• Funnel: qualified conversations -> design partners -> deployments -> production -> paid -> expansion.

• Learning velocity: experiment cycle time, evidence quality, speed at which weak assumptions are killed or corrected.

Operating Model and Reporting

This role works directly with the CEO during zero-to-one discovery and partners closely with Rod, Head of Growth.

Decision rights will be explicit: CipherScale market discovery cannot become an overlapping second growth

organization, and OpenVPN growth priorities cannot dilute CipherScale category discovery. As the motion becomes

repeatable, responsibilities can be consolidated based on evidence rather than titles.

Security Expectations

You will operate with customer and prospect data, AI agents, email/CRM systems, call transcripts, and potentially

technical environments. Treat agents as potentially compromised actors. Use scoped identities, least privilege,

deterministic authorization for external actions, credential isolation, customer-data boundaries, prompt-injection

defenses, audit trails, and human approval for high-impact commitments until explicitly delegated.

Compensation Philosophy

We would rather pay exceptional compensation and meaningful upside for one outstanding founder-level operator

than assemble a large conventional GTM organization. Final structure should reflect experience, location, scope, and

demonstrated ability to create zero-to-one enterprise value.

The Test

A strong candidate should be able to take the Cipherscale thesis, identify the first market to attack, design the first ten

customer experiments, explain what evidence would invalidate the strategy, and show how they would use AI to

execute the work with minimal human headcount.

About Transgender Law Center

Transgender Law Center (TLC) is the largest national, trans-led organization working to set all people free. We champion the rights of all transgender and gender-nonconforming people to make their own choices and live freely, safely, and authentically. Prioritizing BIPOC, disabled, and HIV+ communities, we advance community-driven strategies that harness trans knowledge, power, and joy to ensure that we all not only survive but thrive at all ages and phases of life.

You can learn more about our work at .

About the Position

Transgender Law Center's National Organizer will build power with trans communities across the country by developing leadership, strengthening local and state organizing efforts, and advancing campaigns rooted in racial, gender, and HIV justice. We are seeking a skilled and self-motivated organizer to design and facilitate trainings, convenings, and cohorts that use popular education techniques to build political analysis and grow community leadership. This person will identify emerging issues, support base-building, campaign, and narrative change work, and translate research and needs assessments into strategies that resource and amplify local organizing.

Working across a national network of staff, community leaders, and partners, this person must be able to build authentic relationships while navigating the distinct needs and contexts of different regions and communities. This role requires strong communication skills, including facilitation and writing, sound judgment in issue identification and campaign development, and the project management skills to keep multiple trainings, partnerships, and deliverables moving forward. The ideal candidate is a true organizer at heart, with the instincts to build relationships, read a room, and move people toward shared action. They are flexible and adaptable as priorities shift, follow through on commitments, and jump in to support teammates with coverage as emerging issues arise. Most importantly, they have a deep commitment to advancing racial, gender, and HIV justice through the collective power of BIPOC trans and disabled communities.

Key Responsibilities

National Organizing & Campaign Leadership

  • Lead national organizing efforts aligned with TLC's key priorities, including but not limited to serving as an organizer for the Positively Trans+ program
  • Co-coordinate advocacy campaigns and on-the-ground ballot measure support in priority states
  • Work with partners to develop advocacy and narrative change strategies addressing HIV criminalization and anti-trans legislation
  • Identify emerging policy issues and translate them into organizing, campaign, and narrative priorities
  • Contribute to and support campaigns and organizing across TLC’s programmatic work

Partnership & Coalition Building

  • Build and steward relationships with coalition partners, community organizations, and allied movements
  • Coordinate and collaborate with the Positively Trans+ National Advisory Board (NAB)
  • Represent TLC in external meetings, advocacy spaces, and conferences
  • Collaborate with TLC staff to advance shared strategic goals across programs

Trainings, Convenings & Leadership Development

  • Plan and facilitate regional convenings and national training institutes
  • Develop curriculum and training materials grounded in popular education techniques
  • Design and lead cohorts and workshops that build political analysis and community leadership
  • Facilitate key internal and external meetings related to program and campaign work

Program Management & Communications

  • Manage day-to-day program operations, including meetings, trainings, convenings, and participant engagement
  • Support participants through ongoing communication and relationship-building
  • Disseminate research and needs-assessment findings to inform narrative change and education efforts
  • Draft memos to partners, conference abstracts, and other written materials supporting program and campaign work
  • Track project timelines and deliverables to ensure programs run smoothly and on schedule
  • Participate in organization-wide activities and shared responsibilities that support team alignment and culture

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 1-3 years of experience in national organizing work
  • Demonstrated experience in relationship-building and community organizing, including base-building, fostering community leadership, and supporting local and state organizing efforts nationally
  • Experience planning and facilitating trainings, convenings, and cohorts using popular education techniques grounded in political and popular education
  • Experience with campaign development and narrative change work, including issue identification and disseminating research (such as needs assessments) to inform strategy
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple trainings, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously
  • Strong communication skills, including facilitation and writing, with the ability to draft curriculum, partner memos, and conference abstracts
  • Demonstrated commitment to racial, gender, and HIV justice
  • Experience working with transgender migrants, Black trans communities, communities of color, poor, working class, transgender youth and disability communities and transgender and gender nonconforming communities.

Benefits

  • Medical/dental/vision (TLC covers 100% of premiums for employees, 80% for dependents)
  • Employer-funded Health Reimbursement Account (currently $3,500 per year)
  • Employer-funded Lifestyle Spending Account (currently $1,500 per year)
  • Optional employee-funded Flexible Spending Account
  • Employee Assistance Fund that can grant financial assistance for certain qualifying disasters and personal hardships
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks’ sick leave
  • 19 days’ vacation (24 after 3 years’ employment) and 12 holidays
  • Organizational ‘slowdown’ in winter and summer, including, historically, 2 weeks paid time off in the summer and 2 weeks paid time off at the end of the year (separate from employee vacation time)
  • 2-month paid sabbatical program available after 5 years of employment
  • Retirement plan with partial organizational matching
  • Indemnity insurance for critical illness, hospital confinement, and accidents
  • Professional development & coaching
  • Office setup, phone and internet reimbursement (if working from home)
  • Additional mental health, budgeting, travel, and pet benefits

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Transgender Law Center is proud to be an affirmative action employer. All interested individuals, including Black, Indigenous, and other people of color; women and femmes; people with disabilities; and people who are transgender, intersex, lesbian, gay, bisexual, or queer are particularly urged to apply. For more information about Transgender Law Center please visit our website: .

jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Lead QA Engineer, you'll own testing strategy and quality standards across our most important work; Deciding what should be automated, what needs a human eye, where the real risk is hiding, and acting on it. You'll work hands-on across both manual and automated testing, splitting your time based on what a given release actually needs, while mentoring other engineers and acting as the go-to voice on quality across projects. You've got the critical thinking skills to chase down a hard bug yourself, know when to ask for help and delegate, and the range to set direction for how the whole team approaches quality. You seek to help your coworkers and do so regularly.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead test strategy and quality standards across multiple projects, deciding what warrants automated coverage versus focused manual and exploratory testing.
  • Build and maintain automated test suites in Playwright, and use BrowserStack to validate compatibility across browsers, devices, and platforms.
  • Define and run deep manual and exploratory testing on new, ambiguous, or high-change-rate work where automation isn't the right investment yet.
  • Translate requirements into concrete test plans and acceptance criteria, catching gaps in the requirements themselves before they become gaps in the product.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for quality with stakeholders: communicate risk, resolve disagreements about scope, and negotiate realistic testing timelines.
  • Write clear, actionable defect reports in Jira, drive them to resolution, and verify fixes actually hold up under retest rather than just passing a second glance.
  • Use Jira's linking and epic structure to keep testing work traceable, and flag workflow friction in the board with the team before it slows down the SDLC.
  • Mentor other QA engineers in both manual technique and automation practice, including how to write tickets clearly and so well that they need no follow-up clarification, raising the bar on testing across the team, not just on your own projects.
  • Step into any project at any phase to assess its quality risk and recommend a concrete path forward.
  • Stay ahead of testing tools and practices worth adopting, and bring the right ones into real workflows deliberately.
  • Operate and champion the use of AI tooling with an understanding that its output is useful, but not infallible. You treat AI as a tool, not a coworker.

Craft & Leadership Balance

Estimated 60% leadership, 40% craft.

Qualifications

Required

  • 6-8 years of experience in software quality assurance or testing, ideally with exposure to consulting or multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Strong, hands-on experience with Playwright for building and maintaining automated test suites and frameworks.
  • Experience using BrowserStack (or a comparable cross-browser/device testing platform) to validate compatibility across platforms.
  • Deep grounding in manual, exploratory, and regression testing, with the judgment to know when automation is and isn't the right investment.
  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, actionable test plans and acceptance criteria.
  • Strong Jira practice: writing tickets so well that no follow-up or clarification is needed, using issue-linking for traceability, and spotting workflow friction before it becomes a team-wide problem.
  • Experience testing across a range of CMS or SaaS platforms rather than a single stack, since our client environments vary and this role needs to move between them.
  • Exceedingly strong communication skills, including presenting technical risk and testing tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. It cannot be stressed enough how important this item is: communication is the whole ballgame.
  • Prior experience as a technical or testing lead on large or multi-phase projects.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with performance testing (e.g. Lighthouse) and accessibility testing (e.g. Axe, WCAG guidelines).
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with structured test-case formats (e.g. Gherkin) and test case management tooling.
  • A track record of debugging and performance investigation at scale.
  • Creation and implementation of SDLC processes and norms at project and team scales.

Why Current

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We’re a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

You’ll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, contribute to meaningful digital experiences, and help shape the future of engineering within a growing agency environment.

The target range of base compensation for this role is $85,000 - $110,000 annually. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.
