This project is written for the thoughtful, everyday Bible student who wants to go deeper—without requiring highly technical academic detail. The commentary should reflect careful exegesis and a clearly articulated Christ-centered hermeneutic. Our goal is to land between conversational pastoral commentaries and academic volumes—accessible, theologically rich, and intellectually serious. An ecumenical tone is imperative throughout, engaging interpretive differences with charity and avoiding unnecessary polemics.

Scope of Work

  • Collaborate with a team of contributors under editorial and theological oversight
  • Research and write assigned portions of the Gospels and/or Acts
  • Provide clear, structured commentary that includes:
    • Literary and historical context
    • Explanation of key theological themes
    • Engagement with major interpretive questions
    • Selective interaction with the original languages where illuminating (without becoming technical)
  • Articulate how each passage contributes to the revelation of Christ and the mission of the early church
  • Write for serious lay readers—clear and accessible, but not simplified
  • Address areas of theological disagreement with fairness, clarity, and ecumenical charity
  • Revise material in response to editorial and peer review
  • Ensure alignment with the organization’s doctrinal commitments
  • Explicit Christ-centered and redemptive-historical connections
  • Draw out thoughtful, textually grounded practical application for contemporary readers
  • Write not merely to inform, but to form aiming at spiritual transformation, worship, and deeper trust in Christ

Qualifications

  • Master of Divinity (M.Div.) or another advanced theology degree required
  • Demonstrated competency in New Testament exegesis
  • Working knowledge of Koine Greek
  • A clearly articulated Christ-centered hermeneutic
  • Familiarity with major evangelical scholarship on the Gospels and Acts
  • Demonstrated capacity to engage diverse theological perspectives with humility and care
  • Experience in pastoral ministry, theological education, or substantive Bible teaching preferred
  • Ability to write clearly for educated lay readers
  • Comfortable collaborating within a multi-author theological project
  • Willingness to receive and implement substantive editorial feedback

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish Bible studies—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Submission Requirements

Because this is a collaborative theological project, we require a CV, writing sample, and two statements from applicants. Applicants must submit the following materials in a single PDF document:

Important: Incomplete submissions will not be reviewed.

1. Curriculum Vitae (CV)

Include:

  • Academic degrees (M.Div. required; advanced degrees preferred)
  • Institutions attended
  • Greek coursework and competency
  • Ministry, teaching, or academic experience
  • Previous publications (if applicable)

2. Exegetical Writing Sample (5–10 pages)

Submit one of the following:

  • A previously published exegetical work (preferred), or
  • A freshly written commentary-style sample on a passage from the Gospels or Acts

The sample should demonstrate:

  • Careful engagement with the biblical text
  • Awareness of historical and literary context
  • Clear articulation of theological themes
  • A Christ-centered, covenantal approach
  • Writing accessible to thoughtful lay readers (not overly technical)
  • An ecumenical tone when addressing interpretive differences

3. Hermeneutical Statement (1–2 pages)

Please include a brief statement describing your hermeneutical approach to the Bible.

4. Personal Doctrinal Statement (1–2 pages)

Submit a concise personal doctrinal statement summarizing your theological convictions and expand upon how you approach theological disagreements.

Salary: Determined per project

At Bitrise, we’re transforming how mobile products are developed and deployed for thousands of customers worldwide. Many customers discover us through events that either introduce them to our platform or help them understand a problem they’re facing and how we can solve it.

As the Head of Demand Generation at Bitrise, you’ll be responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing our Demand Generation engine across our self-serve and direct sales GTM motions. You will be responsible for generating high-quality leads that fuel our sales pipeline and drive digital customer acquisition..

Additionally, you will own and manage our marketing tech stack, working closely with Revenue Operations including sales ops, marketing ops, and product teams to create impactful campaigns that resonate with our target audience and deliver on business objectives.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • A get-things-done attitude with an entrepreneurial spirit
  • 7+ years of experience in demand generation at B2B SaaS companies, with working for companies in the $10M-$80M ARR range
  • Experience with building or rebuilding a DemandGen engine, not just inheriting or managing one
  • Proven track record owning a pipeline number and delivering against it with a small team and realistic budget
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to do reverse funnel math, build dashboards, and translate data into actionable decisions
  • Experience with developer marketing or technical buyers, focused on ideal customer profiles in the developer ecosystem
  • Experience operating in a hybrid PLG + sales-led environment and solid understanding on how DemandGen supports both motions
  • Deep familiarity with paid digital (Google Ads, LinkedIn), ABM, content syndication, email nurture, and event-driven pipeline programs
  • Comfortable with intent data platforms (6sense, Bombora) and knows when to keep the martech stack simple rather than adding more tools
  • Actively uses AI tools in their marketing work to move faster, not because it's trendy
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to run multiple campaigns simultaneously without dropping things
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, especially with sales teams
  • Experienced people manager, hiring and scaling growth marketing teams
  • Previously owned SEO & GEO

What would really knock our socks off

  • Experience in DevOps, CI/CD, mobile development tools, or developer platforms
  • Familiarity with running DemandGen during a company positioning shift
  • Experience working directly with BDR/SDR teams to align outbound and marketing programs

Your Role & Responsibilities

  • Own the marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline number across both self-serve and direct sales motions
  • Work backward from bookings targets to define required volume of MQLs, SQLs, and opportunities by channel, by month
  • Build and run multi-channel DemandGen campaigns: paid digital (Google, LinkedIn), email nurture, content syndication, webinars, ABM plays, and event-driven programs
  • Execute campaigns hands-on, not just plan them. Set up campaigns in HubSpot, manage paid media, write briefs, pull reports, and optimize based on performance data
  • Manage and optimize the marketing tech stack with a focus on keeping it lean and effective. Partner with RevOps on lead scoring, routing, attribution, and reporting
  • Build and maintain dashboards tracking pipeline generated, conversion rates by stage, cost per MQL/SQL, channel ROI, and pipeline velocity. Share these openly with no spin
  • Partner with sales and BDRs regularly. Provide the right content, intent signals, and talk tracks. Listen to feedback and actually adjust programs based on it
  • Collaborate with content and product marketing to ensure campaigns reflect Bitrise's positioning as the best platform for mobile, broader DevOps, and AI agent infrastructure
  • Run continuous experiments on subject lines, landing pages, audience segments, channel mix, and messaging. Kill what doesn't work quickly, double down on what does
  • Plan and execute events (owned webinars + third-party conferences) as pipeline programs with measurable targets, not just brand plays
  • Document playbooks, campaign templates, and processes so what you build is repeatable and scalable
  • Managing a team of 3 Marketing Managers - own their performance management, coaching, mentoring and growth with Bitrise

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Pipeline Ownership & Accountability: Can do the math from bookings targets back through conversion rates to figure out exactly how many leads are needed per channel. Builds programs to hit those numbers. Flags issues early and comes with a plan to fix them.
  • Campaign Execution at Speed: Gets campaigns from idea to live fast. Doesn't need 6 weeks to launch an email sequence or a webinar. Bias toward shipping and iterating rather than perfecting in a vacuum.
  • Data Fluency & Analytical Rigor: Builds own reports and dashboards. Understands multi-touch attribution and its limitations. Checks numbers weekly and makes decisions based on data, not gut feel or what worked at their last company.
  • Developer Audience Marketing: Understands that developers and engineering leaders don't respond to traditional B2B marketing. Knows how to create demand through technical content, community involvement, and product-led motions rather then pushy outbound.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Works well with sales, BDRs, content, PMM, and RevOps. Not territorial. Actively seeks feedback from sales on lead quality and adjusts programs accordingly. The kind of marketer sales teams actually want to work with.
  • Marketing Technology Proficiency: Hands-on with HubSpot (or equivalent MAP), Salesforce, paid media platforms, and ABM/intent tools. Can troubleshoot a broken workflow, set up lead scoring, and evaluate whether a new tool is actually worth adding to the stack.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Constantly tests and iterates. Has killed programs that weren't delivering even if they were "supposed to work." Brings ideas to the table proactively, doesn't just execute what they're told.
  • Project Management & Organization: Keeps multiple workstreams moving without letting things slip. Uses project management tools to track timelines and deliverables. Keeps work visible to cross-functional partners.
  • Resilience & Bias to Action: Moves fast in ambiguous environments. Doesn't get stuck waiting for perfect information. Ships, learns, adjusts. Comfortable with the messy reality of building demand gen at a growth-stage company.
  • Transparency & Communication: Tells people what's working and what isn't, straight up. Doesn't hide behind vanity metrics. Gives the CEO and sales leadership a clear, honest picture at all times.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to learn about app development by playing a crucial role in the mobile development process for the world’s most successful companies
  • The security of working in a financially stable, growing company with an ever-expanding global customer base
  • A remote working environment with opportunities for in-person collaboration
  • A global customer portfolio to manage
  • A competitive stock options package
  • Private medical insurance & life assurance

About Bitrise

Bitrise is a continuous integration and delivery platform, built by and for mobile app developers. Our mission? To help everyone build and operate better mobile apps. By streamlining, automating and optimizing recurring mobile development processes, we free up time and resources for creative, interesting and impactful development tasks, resulting in better, faster releases.

As a successful graduate of Y Combinator, we are born of the same DNA as Airbnb and Dropbox. Since Bitrise was launched in 2015, we have grown exponentially: Today, tens of thousands of developers release apps via Bitrise that end up on billions of mobile devices around the world.

Some of the teams who already trust us are Tripadvisor, Shopify, Get Your Guide, or GoDaddy.. Pick up any mobile device, and chances are you’ll encounter multiple apps that were built on Bitrise. Working at Bitrise means contributing to all of that.

Salary: £100,000 - £130,000

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

Step 3 – Let's Actually Talk

A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.

Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Step 6 – Showtime

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way—with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.

Step 7 – The Verdict

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

jobs.description:
About Searchbloom

Searchbloom is an established and growing company. This provides you with the unique opportunity to share your expertise with exceptional digital marketers, make your mark in the organization, and create opportunities for future advancement.

Sr. SEO Specialist (eCommerce)

About the Role
We’re hiring a Senior SEO Specialist to lead strategy, identify high-impact opportunities, and serve as the organic growth lead across a portfolio of high-performing client accounts, with a primary focus on ecommerce partners. You’ll guide partners through SEO strategic roadmaps, execute detailed audits, manage technical prioritization, and drive measurable performance across large product catalogs, category driven architectures, and revenue focused initiatives.

In this role, you will own organic growth for ecommerce brands by improving product and category discoverability, managing indexation at scale, and aligning SEO strategy with merchandising, conversion, and lifetime value goals. You will collaborate closely with content, outreach, paid media, and development teams to ensure SEO recommendations are implemented in ways that support both rankings and revenue.

This is a full-time, remote position that reports to the Director of SEO.

Our SEO team is trusted to lead, not just support. This role is central to how we help partners grow.

Also known as: SEO Strategist, Technical SEO Manager, Organic Search Specialist

About Searchbloom
Searchbloom is an established and growing company. This provides you with the unique opportunity to share your expertise with exceptional digital marketers, make your mark in the organization, and create opportunities for future advancement.

Searchbloom is in search of an experienced SEO Specialist. Come join our team of digital marketers who work great together to do an amazing job for our partners, and play hard along the way. To fit in, you’ve got to be an advanced SEO with a real passion for organic search. We’re looking for people who stay on top of what’s really working and have strong opinions about the implications of strategic approaches. The majority of your workday will be spent identifying, documenting, and prioritizing SEO issues for clients.

Compensation
$75,000 – $90,000 annually, depending on experience, technical depth, and client management skills.

Qualifications

Must-Have:

Ecommerce SEO Expertise (Required)

  • Proven experience scaling SEO for ecommerce sites with hundreds to tens of thousands of SKUs
  • Proven client-facing experience in an agency environment
  • Expertise in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets
    • Advanced proficiency in using formulas, & data manipulation techniques to create meaningful, client-facing analysis through Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets
  • Outstanding communication skills with the ability to influence multiple stakeholders
  • Deep knowledge of SEO tools: Ahrefs, Moz, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, Google Analytics
  • Experience implementing and validating ecommerce structured data, including Product, Review, Offer, and Breadcrumb schema
  • Hands-on experience optimizing category pages and product detail pages (PDPs) for search visibility and conversion support
  • Experience developing, managing, executing, and measuring SEO campaigns for medium-to-large brands and eCommerce websites
  • Strong understanding of page-level SEO, site architecture, technical audits, and structured data
  • Experience with AEO/ AI SEO strategies including featured snippet and AIO targeting, FAQ markup, entity optimization, and search intent mapping
  • Familiarity with basic HTML, CSS, PHP and JavaScript concepts
  • Experience supporting or collaborating on product feed optimization and feed management solutions that impact organic shopping visibility
  • Working knowledge of recent and ongoing algorithm changes including Helpful Content updates, Core Web Vitals, spam signal updates (e.g., SpamBrain), and the implications of generative AI on search
  • Proven experience collaborating with Paid Media, Dev, and Content teams though: meeting preparation, client-facing communications, running joint meetings,
  • Specialist in ecommerce SEO

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Looker Studio (Data Studio), Supermetrics, or other reporting tools
  • Familiarity with AI-driven tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini Surfer, Peec AI, Profound AI, etc.
  • Familiarity with common CMS softwares; especially Wordpress with Woocommerce, Shopify, Magento, BigCommerce
  • Experience using Google Tag Manager for tracking setups, including event and key event configuration in GA4
  • Experience creating and managing custom reports and dashboards in GA4

Key Behaviors

  • Moldability / adaptability - Successful bloomers bring their diverse set of experience to the role, but use this to adopt and excel performing work “The Searchbloom way”. Successful candidates can take / give feedback to adapt & grow
  • “A Player” - We do not accept mediocrity, everyone in Searchbloom is expected to contribute to “unified excellence” / one experience. A key component of this is ‘player’ (i.e. employee must operate in and thrive as a team)
  • Attitude > Aptitude
  • “Core Values” - Candidates live and execute these values regularly
  • Transparency / Integrity - As a remote workforce we expect high-degrees of proactivity & self-management. Work must be completed on time, and according to standards. We expect not to have to manage ‘the basics’ (standards of professional conduct, etc)
  • 6 week ramp-up - Successful candidates must be able to manage accounts in a partner-facing capacity within six weeks
  • Strategic thinking - Candidates must be able to create, articulate, execute, & pivot strategic actions (roadmap). Doing so requires ability to be empathetic and understand true partner goals beyond just results

Responsibilities

  • Lead the SEO relationship for your assigned clients
  • Own SEO strategy for category, subcategory, and product detail pages, balancing crawl efficiency, rankings, and conversion support
  • Audit and optimize PDP and category templates for structured data, internal linking, indexation, and performance at scale
  • Lead client calls as the primary SEO voice, educate, recommend, and defend strategic direction
  • Perform advanced audits using a suite of SEO tools to surface technical and content opportunities
  • Write Point of View (POV) documents and recommendations based on partner needs and data
  • Prioritize initiatives by difficulty, cost, and potential impact, make budget recommendations
  • Partner with Paid Media and ecommerce teams on product feed optimization to improve organic shopping visibility
  • Collaborate with Paid Media, Content, and Development teams to execute multi-channel strategies
  • Execute SEO deliverables such as keyword research, on-page optimization, internal linking, competitive gap analysis, and technical improvements
  • Conduct QA on SEO deliverables produced by SEO peers
  • Identify risks and opportunities related to SKU sprawl, thin PDPs, duplicate categories, and parameter driven URLs
  • Monitor performance and iterate strategy based on analytics and client KPIs
  • Mentor junior SEO talent as needed and contribute to improving our internal SEO playbooks
  • Proactively surface new opportunities and test ideas that improve results (within above-mentioned frameworks of prioritization)
  • Use AI to scale audits, surface gaps, or assist with content ideation, while relying on human strategy for final decision-making

Key Performance Indicators

  • ROI for your partners
  • Partner retention
  • Organic traffic growth
  • SEO-driven conversion volume
  • Technical SEO health scores
  • Net Promoter Score

Why Choose Searchbloom?

Health & Financial:

  • Health/Vision/Dental Coverage – PPO or HSA plans available
  • $50,000 in life insurance paid by Searchbloom

Time Off:

  • 14 days of PTO in year one
  • 13 company holidays, including full week off for Christmas
  • Your birthday and work anniversary off

Work Environment:

  • 100% remote agency
  • Flexible work hours
  • Business casual dress code
  • Office Improvement Credit

Growth & Culture:

  • Searchbloom promotes almost exclusively from within
  • $50,000+ invested in annual Learning & Development across our team
  • Paid parental leave (maternity & paternity)
  • Employee Wellness Program (free Fitbit + fitness challenges)
  • Awarded Best Place to Work by Inc. (twice)

You’ll work with a passionate, driven team where we pride ourselves on delivering high-quality work that makes a real-world impact for our partners.

What Our Team Says
“The CEO is one of the best people I have ever met. He cares about every single employee and their success. Wicked smart as well.”
“Excellent opportunities to learn and grow. They won’t make you work with awful clients.”
“Fun and diverse partnerships, supportive team, great work-life balance.”

We are seeking an experienced Container Platform Engineer to design, deploy, and operate enterprise-grade Red Hat OpenShift container platforms running mission-critical workloads across on-premises and cloud environments. In this role you will own the end-to-end platform lifecycle — from cluster provisioning and hardening, through workload onboarding and developer enablement, to ongoing operations and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in OpenShift and Kubernetes internals, strong Linux fundamentals, and a security-first mindset, and will partner with application teams, security engineers, and infrastructure stakeholders to deliver a stable, secure, and developer-friendly container platform.

  • Mentor junior engineers and act as an OpenShift subject-matter expert across the broader organization.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Strong Linux administration skills, including networking, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Helm.
  • Solid experience implementing CI/CD pipelines on OpenShift or Kubernetes using Tekton, Jenkins, or Argo CD.
  • Strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, or Go.

  • Familiarity with container image security and supply chain hardening.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Develop content that thoughtfully integrates photography, Scripture, personal reflection, storytelling, and biblical encouragement
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Work with the design and editorial teams to ensure strong integration between visual and written content

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one

  • Education

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

11. Sample Material

  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript

jobs.excerpt: CancerNavigator is a healthcare startup dedicated to supporting cancer patients in their hour of need.
jobs.description:
CancerNavigator is a healthcare startup dedicated to supporting cancer patients in their hour of need.

Our Mission & Our Work, in Brief

Cancer is the number one cause of death for commercially insured Americans and the top cost driver for health plans. And, cancer patients are struggling.

CancerNavigator is a white-glove, end-to-end, cancer support service for patients and their families. We work with health plans across the country to provide 1-1 support to members facing a cancer diagnosis. Our support is delivered through dedicated Oncology Certified Nurses, who help members get to fantastic experts for their care and help them through the thousands of other problems that arise across the cancer journey.

Join us to serve cancer patients in their hour of need.

The “VP of Engineering” Role

Role and Team:

As VP of Engineering, you’ll join CancerNavigator at a pivotal stage of growth and have the opportunity to shape what our engineering function becomes. Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll initially operate as a highly hands-on technical leader—setting the technical strategy, defining the roadmap, and building alongside the team. Over time, you’ll take on leadership of our existing technical resources and build out the engineering organization needed to support our next stage of scale.

This is not a role where you’ll inherit a mature engineering organization or a predefined roadmap. You’ll work closely with leaders across the business to understand how our service operates today, identify the highest-impact opportunities for technology, and determine what we should build, buy, automate, or redesign.

Daily Work:

This is a highly entrepreneurial, hands-on leadership role. You’ll have significant autonomy to shape both what we build and how engineering operates at CancerNavigator. You will:

  • Partner with our CEO and functional leaders to set the technical strategy and roadmap for the business.
  • Identify the highest-impact opportunities to use technology and AI to help our team serve more patients at scale.
  • Design and build foundational systems, particularly in the early stages of the role.
  • Lead the development of tools across patient navigation, communication, research, and healthcare data processing.
  • Grow and lead our engineering function, establishing the team, infrastructure, and practices we’ll need for our next stage of growth.

The Requirements

  • Engineering leadership experience, ideally in a VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, or similar role within a health tech company.
  • Strong experience building technology in healthcare, with a deep understanding of HIPAA and the security, privacy, and data considerations that come with handling sensitive health information.
  • A track record of taking complex technical problems from strategy through architecture and hands-on execution.
  • Experience building and scaling technology for a tech-enabled service or other operationally complex business.
  • Experience with modern data infrastructure and cloud-based systems, with familiarity in Python and SQL.
  • Experience applying AI to automate back-end workflows, augment human operations, and build real-world products.
  • An entrepreneurial, hands-on approach—you’re comfortable setting the strategy, operating with ambiguity, and rolling up your sleeves to build.

Strongly preferred: Experience working with medical claims, prior authorization, or other complex healthcare data.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive salary and stock option package
  • Performance-based incentive compensation
  • Remote-first work; live where you want within the U.S.
  • All-company on-sites 2-3 times per year
  • Medical and Dental Insurance (80% employer paid), Vision Insurance (100% employer paid)
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
  • Group Life and AD&D Insurance (involuntary with the option to buy-up coverage)
  • Unlimited PTO

Our Culture & Values, In Brief

We’re building a company where what we do matters. The goal couldn’t be clearer – serve cancer patients. As the business grows, and the work becomes more complex, we need to become more, not less, committed to why we are doing this.

We have three company values, which guide our company:

  1. Patients first, always: In everything we do, we put the cancer patient (and their families) first; we exist to serve them in their most urgent moments.
  2. Respect for our responsibility: We strive, as a team, to respect the gravity of the responsibility we bear to patients, always acting and producing in a way that is worthy of the trust they have placed in us.
  3. Kindness to and respect for others: We treat our teammates well, no exceptions. We are one team.

At CancerNavigator, we believe a well-rounded and diverse team is a key to our success. We never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.

jobs.excerpt: Location: RemotePosition OverviewWe are seeking contract writers to develop Christ-centered Bible studies.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking contract writers to develop Christ-centered Bible studies. These studies should offer in-depth theology readers can truly understand—grounded in careful exegesis and a Christ-centered hermeneutic—while remaining accessible to serious lay readers and church groups. Our aim is not merely to inform but to cultivate spiritual transformation, helping readers experience the grace of Jesus and grow in faithful obedience.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a complete Bible study in Daily Grace's Bible study format
  • Write with theological depth that remains clear and understandable
  • Intentionally guide readers toward spiritual formation and lived obedience
  • Maintain an ecumenical tone when engaging theological issues and interpretive differences
  • Collaborate with the editorial team through multiple rounds of review and revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with the organization’s doctrinal commitment

Qualifications

  • Master of Divinity (M.Div.) or another advanced theological degree strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated competency in biblical exegesis
  • A clearly articulated Christ-centered hermeneutic
  • Experience writing or teaching Bible studies for lay audiences
  • Ability to communicate complex theological ideas with clarity and pastoral sensitivity
  • Comfortable collaborating within a team-based editorial process
  • Willingness to receive and implement substantive feedback

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish Bible studies—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important: Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

Please submit all materials in a single document and include:

1. Suggested title and subtitle.

2. Controlling idea of the Bible study: In one sentence, state the central theological message of the biblical text as this study will present it, and the transformation it aims to produce in the reader.
3. A summary of resources that will be used and how they will inform your theological approach: Describe the key sources that will inform your interpretation and application of this biblical text, including commentaries or theological works, and explain how these sources shape your approach and serve the intended reader.
4. A list of potential theological issues and interpretive issues: Provide a brief list of potential theological tensions, debated interpretive issues, or common application pitfalls that arise from this biblical text, and explain how you plan to address them faithfully and in accordance with TDGC’s ecumenical approach.

5. Target audience description: Explain who is this Bible study written for and why it matters to them.

6. Comparable titles: Include 2–3 comparable Bible studies and explain how this study is distinct from each one.

7. Author bio: Explain what makes you uniquely qualified to write this book.

8. Complete Bible study outline: For each day of the study, please include the passage to be studied and a one sentence summary of the the main idea of the passage. It should be clear how the outline supports the controlling idea. Except for year-long Bible studies, each week of the study should contain 5 days of study content and two rest days.
9. Three complete sample Bible study days: Please include at least three sample days of the study. Each day should provide 750–1000 words of commentary on one passage of Scripture. The commentary should be engaging, informational, Christ-centered, and should offer specific real-life points of application. It should also include two questions for reflection and application and one prayer prompt.
10. Front and back matter: describe any supplemental material the Bible study will include such as maps, charts, illustrations, timelines, etc.

11. Timeline and specifications: include current manuscript status (work in progress, complete, etc.), anticipated manuscript delivery date, and any other information that is relevant to provide.

Bible Study Topics of Particular Interest

We are especially interested in proposals in the following categories:

Expositional Studies

  • Leviticus
  • Deuteronomy
  • Ezra
  • Proverbs
  • Song of Songs
  • Jeremiah
  • Matthew
  • 1 & 2 Corinthians (one cohesive study covering both books)
  • 1 & 2 Timothy

Topical Exposition Studies

  • Forgiveness
  • Creating and Living a Rule of Life
  • Addressing Current Cultural Issues
  • God’s Goodness
  • Developing Biblical Discernment
  • Marriage

Studies to Guide Readers Through Church Calendar Seasons

  • Lent
  • Advent

Year-Long Studies

  • 52-Week Studies
  • 365-Day Studies

jobs.description:
Job Title: Director, Major Gifts

Organizational Unit: Development

Reports To: Chief Development Officer

Supervises: Mid-level Giving & Prospecting Officer

Location: Equality Now is a remote organization. This position may be based in Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Virginia, or Washington, D.C., with a strong preference for candidates based in New York.

MISSION OBJECTIVE:

The Director, Major Gifts plays a pivotal role in advancing Equality Now’s global mission by leading and growing a major gifts portfolio, including gala sponsorships, mid-level giving and donor engagement. In partnership with the Chief Development Officer and Chief Executive Officer, the Director translates Equality Now’s development strategy into actionable fundraising plans, strengthens donor pipelines and systems, and cultivates meaningful relationships with individuals, family foundations, and philanthropic networks.This role spans strategy, donor cultivation and stewardship, portfolio management, events, executive engagement, and team leadership, and collaborates closely with Annual Giving & Development Operations functions. It requires an experienced fundraising leader with sound judgment, strong relationship-management skills, cross-cultural fluency, and the ability to translate Equality Now’s complex legal and programmatic work into compelling opportunities for philanthropic investment.

The Director will have the opportunity to shape and strengthen Equality Now’s Individual and Major Giving program during an important period of organizational growth. The successful candidate must be comfortable building systems, navigating complexity, inspiring donors and colleagues, and building the capacity of supervisee(s) and other junior staff focused on securing sustainable revenue to advance legal and systemic change for women and girls worldwide.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

The following provides a general outline of the role. It is not exhaustive, and responsibilities may evolve at the discretion of the CDO based on organizational needs and priorities.

Purpose: Innovate for Mission Expansion

  • Serve as the senior lead for operationalizing the Individual & Major Giving strategy, translating our 2026-2030 development strategy into actionable plans, systems, and donor pathways across the full Individual Giving portfolio.
  • Drive the execution and refinement of Equality Now’s high-touch major donor growth strategy, including implementing a network-mapping approach, strengthening Advisory Board and Ambassador engagement, building individualized strategies for UHNW, and designing innovative donor/prospect engagement initiatives (eg-salons, donor cohorts, donor journeys, in-kind/volunteer opportunities for mission impact)
  • Partner with the CEO and CDO to support high-value donor/prospect cultivation and shape donor-facing opportunities aligned with organizational priorities, advising on donor motivations, portfolio insights, and potential engagement opportunities.
  • Provide strategic leadership to align all tiers of individual giving—major gifts, gala sponsorships, mid-level, and annual giving—ensuring cohesive messaging, clear donor journeys, and seamless handoffs between donor segments.
  • Lead maintenance and continuous improvement of pipeline development and tracking practices, including
    donor qualification, engagement strategies, moves management, and standardized systems that enhance efficiency, clarity, and visibility across the portfolio.
  • Lead/guide the development of donor-facing cases for support, investment opportunities, and strategic offerings, ensuring they reflect Equality Now’s mission, program vision, and funder-aligned messaging.

Engagement: Advocate

  • Manage a portfolio of high-value donors and prospects, cultivating deep, trust-based relationships with individuals and family foundations capable of $10,000–$250,000+ giving, while identifying opportunities and supporting leadership-level engagement.
  • Support CEO and CDO engagement with top-tier donors and prospects, preparing strategic briefings, donor intelligence, outreach recommendations, follow-up plans, and bespoke cultivation opportunities.
  • Oversee and elevate the mid-level donor program, ensuring a compelling donor journey that supports upgrades and helps to surface and convert major donor prospects.
  • Engage and activate Advisory Board members and other supporters and ambassadors, partnering with them to leverage networks, cultivate prospective donors, support events, and build community around Equality Now.
  • Serve as an external ambassador for Equality Now, representing the mission with fluency in global women’s rights and human rights–cultivating relationships and expanding networks in philanthropic and peer spaces.
  • Ensure donor experiences reflect mission-driven, community-centered engagement, including opportunities to meet international staff, join learning conversations, attend cultivation events, and participate in curated donor experiences.
  • Strengthen departmental and cross-departmental collaboration, to ensure donor messaging is programmatically accurate, compelling, and aligned with organizational impact narratives, and that the development program gains efficiencies and effectiveness through collaboration across corporate, institutional and individual giving.

Delivery: Define Project Cycle

  • Lead the operational management of the entire Major & Mid-levelGiving portfolio, overseeing processes, timelines, deliverables, and performance standards across major gifts, gala sponsorships, mid-level giving, and annual giving.
  • Implement and oversee strong systems for donor/prospect planning and tracking, including moves management, portfolio assignment, forecasting, and performance analytics, ensuring leadership always has clear visibility into pipeline health.
  • Partner with the Manager, Annual Fund & Development Operations, to ensure excellence in development operations, data integrity, analytics, and annual fund growth strategies.
  • Contribute to the planning and execution of high-impact donor events with Comms & Development colleagues, including the gala, cultivation salons, and community-building convenings, ensuring events advance the 2026-2030 development strategy and build momentum for donor/prospect engagement and pipeline development.
  • Develop individualized donor strategies and annual engagement plans, ensuring they are tailored to the donors’ interests, mission-centered, and coordinated with leadership involvement and organizational priorities and opportunities.
  • Produce high-quality donor communications and materials, partnering with Programs and Communications to prepare proposals, impact updates, donor briefings and reports, strategic correspondence, and leadership-level messaging.
  • Ensure accurate reporting, analytics, and revenue projections, synthesizing donor engagement metrics, portfolio movement, and pipeline health to support leadership decision-making and organizational planning.
  • Drive continuous learning and adaptive planning, integrating donor insights, event performance, campaign outcomes, and Strategic Plan benchmarks into ongoing improvements to Major Giving and Mid-level gift operations.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

This position supervises staff and is responsible for providing leadership, guidance, development, and performance management. Responsibilities may evolve based on organizational needs.

Leadership and Team Management

  • Provide clear direction, priorities, and performance expectations to direct reports.
  • Hold regular check-ins, monitor performance, provide timely feedback, and support professional growth.
  • Foster an inclusive, accountable, transparent, and high-performing team culture.
  • Address operational and personnel issues promptly, fairly, and in coordination with People & Culture when appropriate.

Performance and Development

  • Conduct performance reviews and identify individual and team development needs.
  • Coach and mentor staff to strengthen fundraising, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
  • Promote cross-functional learning and knowledge sharing.

Operations and Workflow

  • Manage workflows, priorities, workloads, leave, and coverage to maintain operational continuity.
  • Monitor progress, quality, and outcomes against agreed objectives.
  • Hold regular team meetings to communicate priorities, share updates, and address challenges.

Compliance and Collaboration

  • Ensure adherence to organizational policies, ethical standards, safeguarding requirements, and applicable laws.
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across departments and leadership.
  • Model Equality Now’s values of integrity and accountability, inclusiveness, resilience, and empathy.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS & TARGET SKILLS PROFILE:
The Director will be thoroughly committed to Equality Now’s mission. The position requires deep subject-matter expertise, visionary leadership, and functional integration capacity. Specific requirements include:

Substantive Knowledge

  • Deep expertise in major gift fundraising, high-touch donor engagement strategies, and best practice moves management, ideally in a global nonprofit setting, with demonstrated success in securing 5–7 figure gifts from individuals and family foundations
  • Strong understanding or direct experience in event fundraising, high-touch donor engagement and strengthening development operations and workflows.
  • Familiarity with global human rights, women’s rights and gender equality funding landscapes (highly desirable). Understanding of legal, advocacy and movement building approaches is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage, mentor and develop staff.


Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Spanish, French, or Arabic is a plus.
  • Adept at fostering cross-cultural collaboration and cultivating trust-based relationships consistent with the mission and values of Equality Now.
  • Exceptional donor relationship management and communication skills, with a demonstrated aptitude for translating complex legal, financial, and programmatic concepts into compelling, polished, audience-specific decks, proposals and cases for support.
  • Strong listening, verbal and interpersonal skills to engage professionally and effectively with HNW donors, senior leadership, partners, and staff across geographies and cultures.
  • Adept at facilitating cross-functional collaboration, ensuring clarity, transparency, and strategic alignment between Development, Programs, and Finance, while fostering trust, accountability, and mutual respect across diverse and dispersed teams.


Execution Skills

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with a focus on strategic delivery and operational excellence.
  • Proven ability to recruit, mentor, and manage staff, fellows, and consultants, fostering high-performing, accountable teams, while modeling inclusive leadership, ensuring all voices are heard, valued, and meaningfully integrated into decision-making processes.
  • Strategic and creative thinker with a record of translating vision into measurable outcomes.
  • Strong project management skills with a track record of meeting deadlines and producing high-quality deliverables in fast-paced environments.
  • Highly organized, results-oriented, and adaptable, with experience in database management (Raiser’s Edge NXT or equivalent).
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally and domestically, sometimes on short notice, to support regional teams, engage with partners, and represent Equality Now.

Targeted Specialized Knowledge

  • Bachelor's degree required, Master’s degree, Continuing Education or significant professional experience in relevant fields is highly desired (e.g., International Relations, Nonprofit Management, Public Policy, Law, Human Rights, CFRE certification, etc)
  • 10+ years of progressively responsible fundraising experience, including substantial, independent donor-facing work and staff/program management responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated success working in a global human rights, gender equality, or related international NGO context, with proven ability to navigate diverse and complex organizations is preferred.

COMPENSATION:

At Equality Now, our compensation philosophy reflects our commitment to advancing the human rights of women and girls through lasting legal and systemic change. We approach pay holistically, recognizing base salary as one part of a broader total rewards package designed to support employee wellbeing, growth, and long-term engagement.

  • Base Salary Range: $120,000–$140,000 USD

The final offer will be determined based on several factors, including geographic location, relevant experience, demonstrated skills, qualifications, and internal equity. Equality Now also provides a comprehensive total rewards package, including health and retirement benefits, generous leave, and professional development opportunities.

HOW TO APPLY:

Applicants must submit a resume or CV and a cover letter. Incomplete applications will not be considered. The application period will close at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on September 30, 2026. Due to the anticipated volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Equality Now is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Equality Now is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employees are selected based on their qualifications and ability, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, language, political or other opinion, nationality, ethnic or social origin, disability, pregnancy, mental status, HIV status, age, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. We welcome and value all forms of diversity.

Salary: Base Salary Range: $120,000 - $140,000 USD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. Working alongside engineering leadership and cross-functional discipline teams, you will guide strategic technology decisions, design scalable solutions, and build robust pipelines, services, and tools that support NPR and our Member Station Network.

In this role, you will lead technology strategy across our most complex engineering initiatives—those impacting multiple product lines, distributed systems, and mobile platforms simultaneously. Responsible for end-to-end architecture from platform services to client applications and downstream data pipelines, you will balance system performance, developer velocity, data privacy, and cost-efficiency to deliver exceptional public media experiences at scale.

Responsibilities

Architectural Strategy & System Design

  1. Architect Unified Mobile & Cross-Platform Systems: Define and implement shared architectural patterns and modular design systems across native iOS and Android codebases and cross-platform integrations to maximize code reuse and development velocity.
  2. Design Scalable Personalization & Delivery Pipelines: Lead platform-to-client architecture for personalized content delivery, supporting high-traffic, localized media experiences across owned digital properties and member station networks.
  3. Drive Technology Standards & Evaluation: Conduct technical evaluations for custom builds versus vendor solutions; introduce modern technologies and establish architectural standards across divisions.

Cross-Team Collaboration & Governance

  1. Lead Multi-Team Engineering Initiatives: Provide technical oversight and direction across cross-divisional product roadmaps, project proposals, and OKR planning cycles for multi-team initiatives.
  2. Establish Quality & Code Governance: Conduct architectural proposals and code reviews, providing substantive feedback on system designs, security protocols, workflows, and peer-written software.
  3. Integrate Compliance & Cost Controls: Architect solutions with explicit focus on privacy compliance (GDPR/CPRA), security standards, CDN caching strategies, and cloud cost optimization frameworks.

Operational Excellence & Mentorship

  1. Support Deployment & Operational Resilience: Participate in automated deployments across QA, UAT, and production environments; join the developer on-call rotation to diagnose and resolve critical incidents.
  2. Contribute High-Quality Code: Author documented, resilient code and reusable core libraries aligned with department standards and sprint commitments.
  3. Foster Technical Mentorship & Team Growth: Assist in onboarding, training, and interviewing software engineering staff, advocating for efficient agile processes and inclusive team practices.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Multi-Team System Architecture: 7+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including demonstrated success designing and leading technical architecture for complex, multi-team platform environments.
  • Native Mobile Engineering Expertise: Deep technical proficiency in native mobile architecture (iOS and Android) using languages such as Swift, Kotlin, Java, or Objective-C.
  • Scalable Platform & API Design: Proven track record designing high-traffic, resilient distributed systems, RESTful/GraphQL APIs, and client-server integration patterns.
  • Media Delivery & Infrastructure: Practical experience architecting media playback, streaming protocols, CDN configurations, and cloud infrastructure ecosystems (e.g., AWS or GCP).
  • Data Privacy & Cost Optimization: Hands-on experience integrating data privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CPRA) alongside cloud cost optimization frameworks in high-availability environments.
  • CI/CD & Quality Automation: Demonstrated experience with modern version control systems (Git), continuous integration pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Polyglot Backend Systems: Familiarity with modern backend languages such as Go or PHP in event-driven or microservice architectures.
  • Advanced Caching & Open Source: Experience optimizing edge media caches, working with relational databases/SQL, or contributing to open-source software initiatives.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Cross-Functional Technical Governance: Ability to translate complex business and product requirements into clear, practical architectural designs accepted across multiple engineering teams.

CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE SPECIALIST

Allied Roofing Partners

Remote | Full-Time | Hourly

$18.00–$22.00 per hour, based on experience

ABOUT THE ROLE

A Customer Experience (CX) Specialist is often the first person a homeowner talks to—whether they've called, filled out a web form, or clicked a social ad.

The CX Specialist role is designed to make sure customers hear back in minutes, not hours. CX will also help existing customers with questions and/or basic information as needed.

This role blends customer service and appointment setting. You'll work from proven scripts and playbooks while bringing real listening and judgment to every call.

You'll start by supporting Capstone Roofing, with room to grow into other brands and tools as our CX team expands.

Our goal is simple: Homeowners feel supported, not processed.

POSITION DETAILS

  • Location: Remote – United States(preferred Pst TIme)

• Employment Type: Full-Time, Hourly

  • Compensation: $18.00–$22.00 per hour, based on experience
    • Schedule: Daytime business hours, with evening and Saturday coverage during peak season
    • Overtime available
    • Reports to: Assistant Director, Customer Experience

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Outbound – Appointment Setting & Recovery

  • Call back homeowners who reached out but haven't booked and get them scheduled.
    • Work our recovery list of missed calls and unworked web leads. These are a high priority because they are leads we've already paid for.
    • When time allows, re-engage past quotes, older estimates, and past customers to help fill the calendar further out.

Inbound Customer Experience

  • Answer inbound calls from homeowners requesting to book an inspection or estimate.
    • Assist existing customers with job-related or basic questions.
    • Respond to new website and social media leads within minutes.

• Log every interaction in the CRM.

  • Transfer billing questions finance team.

Expectations

  • Follow our calling cadence, scripts, and playbooks while adapting with good judgment when a situation calls for it.
    • Meet daily and weekly targets for response speed, contact rate, and appointments booked.
    • Provide a professional, friendly, and helpful experience during every customer interaction.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

  • Phone-based customer service, appointment setting, inside sales, or call-center experience, including experience working with scripts or playbooks.
    • Clear, confident, and friendly phone presence.

• Persistent without being pushy.

  • Empathy, patience, and quick thinking with the ability to respond thoughtfully rather than react.
    • Strong comfort with technology and the ability to learn and move between a CRM, dialer or softphone, and other tools as they evolve.
    • Self-discipline and the ability to work productively from home.
    • Quiet, professional home workspace with reliable high-speed internet.
    • Coachable and goal-driven mindset.
    • Authorization to work in the United States.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in roofing, home services, or another trades or contractor business.

• Bilingual with conversational Spanish.

  • Previous lead-recovery calling experience.

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

Weeks 1–2

  • Learn Capstone's scripts and systems.

• Shadow live calls.

  • Begin handling inbound calls with support.

By Day 30

  • Handle inbound calls independently.

• Begin working the recovery list.

By Day 90

  • Consistently meet contact-rate and appointment-setting targets across inbound, recovery, and re-engagement work.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • $18.00–$22.00 per hour, based on experience
    • Medical insurance and company sponsored life insurance

• Dental insurance

• Vision insurance• 401(k)

  • Paid time off
    • Paid holidays

• Equipment and software provided

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants and employees with disabilities.

Salary: $18.00–$22.00 per hour, based on experience

  • Operations Management experience

  • Flexible consultancy assignments
  • Remote and hybrid working opportunities
  • Access to Delphi's specialist support network
  • Ongoing project support
  • Prompt payment of approved invoices
  • A variety of registration and compliance projects
  • Opportunities for repeat and long-term consultancy assignments
  • The flexibility and autonomy of self-employed consultancy work

jobs.description:
Manage & optimise campaigns across our magazine, summit and membership products

$3,000 - $4,000 per month | Full-time | Remote (UK, US overlap)

Watch this short video from Mark, our founder —

Autism Parenting Magazine is a publishing company supporting parents of autistic children with practical, expert-backed strategies they can use right away. We publish a monthly magazine, run our biannual Autism Parenting Summits, and operate a video-based membership subscription.

APM thrives in a fast-paced, high-performance environment. Our global, remote-first team spans the UK, USA, Philippines, South Africa, and Eastern Europe and is growing rapidly.

We use EOS to keep alignment and accountability, meet weekly, and use Hubstaff for time tracking.

We spend around $1 million a year on paid advertising, predominantly on Meta, with Google, Pinterest and Bing alongside it. That spend is the growth engine of the business, and right now our founder is running it himself. We need someone to take the execution off his hands.

This is a hands-on execution role, not a leadership one. You will not manage a team and you will not be asked to invent our marketing strategy from scratch.

Mark has been doing performance marketing for over 16 years and has a growth playbook that works in this niche, built around the Customer Value Journey, where we earn awareness and trust before we ask for the sale. Your job is to take that strategy and run it brilliantly, at pace, with real accountability for the numbers. Over time, as you learn the niche, you'll take increasing ownership and there's a genuine path to growing into the strategist seat. But that's earned over 12 months, not granted on day one.

What you'll be doing

📈 Paid Media & Growth: Meta will be your primary channel, so you should already be strong at building, managing and optimising campaigns at scale. You’ll also help expand into Google Search, Performance Max and Demand Gen, with future testing across channels such as TikTok and AppLovin.

📊 Analytics & Attribution:Use Meta Ads Manager, GA4 and Hyros to understand campaign and funnel performance. Compare data across platforms, spot tracking or attribution issues, and make decisions based on the best available evidence rather than blindly trusting one source.

✍️ Copywriting & Email Marketing: Write Meta ads, headlines, hooks, UGC scripts, landing-page copy and marketing emails. This may include promotional emails, nurture sequences, launch emails and follow-up campaigns.

🎨 Creative Production: Personally create and finalise static and video ads, including variations, UGC scripts and briefs, footage selection, editing, captions and overlays. Use tools such as Canva, ChatGPT, CapCut and other AI/creative tools to move quickly from concept to launch-ready creative.

🎯 Landing Pages & Funnels: Help improve lead-generation and sales pages, with a focus on message match and conversion rate optimisation.

🌐 SEO, Organic Social, Affiliate, & Offline Growth: Improve lead generation and subscription sales through development of our SEO, organic social, affiliate, and offline marketing efforts.

This is a full-time role, UK-based, with some overlap with US hours when needed for commercial or supplier meetings.

Requirements

✅ 3–5 years of hands-on paid advertising experience

✅ Strong practical Meta Ads experience — this is the non-negotiable one

✅ Experience managing meaningful monthly budgets (we'd love to see $50k+/month, but we care more about how you thought about the money than the size of it)

✅ Solid grasp of CAC, ROAS, CTR, CPC, LTV and conversion rate, and comfort being measured on them

✅ Comfortable in Meta Ads Manager and GA4, and able to spot patterns and when tracking or attribution data looks wrong and investigate

✅ Experience with Hyros or another attribution platform is highly desirable

✅ Strong written English and comfort writing direct-response advertising and email copy

✅ Good creative instincts and real curiosity about why one ad beats another

✅ Experience marketing in a compliance-sensitive niche health, medical, supplements, finance or similar is a significant advantage

✅ High attention to detail and strong self-QA: you check the landing page is live before you turn the spend on

✅ Coachable. You can take direction, ask good questions, disagree well, and then commit

✅ Experience with subscription or membership businesses, digital products, launches or events, email platforms, UGC, video editing, Canva and CRO is a bonus.

A note on how we market

We're marketing to overwhelmed parents in a sensitive niche, and words matter enormously both ethically and practically. There are specific ways of phrasing things that keep us compliant with Meta, and getting this wrong can get our ad account banned. We have zero tolerance for carelessness here. If you've worked somewhere the platform rules genuinely bite, you'll know exactly what we mean.

You're a great fit if…

✨ You're strong on Meta and want to become a more rounded direct-response marketer

✨ You enjoy the numbers and want to be accountable for commercial results

✨ You like running frequent tests and turning results into the next round of decisions

✨ You'd rather produce and launch things yourself than manage other people

✨ You're confident enough to bring ideas and challenge assumptions, and humble enough to accept that a business 16 years into its niche might already know some things you don't

✨ Your definition of "done" is work that sells, not work that was submitted by the deadline

✨ You take ownership rather than waiting for someone else to spot the problem

This role is NOT for you if…

❎ You want to be the strategist, or you want complete ownership of marketing direction

❎ You mainly want to manage other marketers

❎ You're primarily a brand marketer, or you prefer reach and engagement over revenue, CAC and ROAS

❎ You accept the numbers Meta shows you without ever questioning attribution or tracking quality

❎ You arrive with a fixed playbook from your last job and expect it to work here without adaptation

❎ You only want to work inside Ads Manager and expect other people to handle copy, creative, email and landing pages

❎ You dislike detailed feedback or get defensive when your ideas are questioned

❎ You prefer discussing strategy to launching and improving campaigns

❎ You need someone to keep telling you what to do next

Learning & development

We don't expect you to know everything. Mark will coach you directly on the playbook and the niche.

Be warned that this niche takes time. Most people need around six months to really get it. We're interested in someone hungry to learn and stick with it, not someone who believes they already have the answers.

jobs.description:
About Yordas Group
Yordas Group is an international provider of scientific and consultancy services, regulatory advice and training to industry in chemicals management, sustainability and risk assessment. We help companies understand and comply with the regulatory requirements affecting their products and supply chains. Our Hazard Communication team works with clients around the world to ensure chemical products are classified, documented and communicated safely and compliantly across different markets.

The opportunity
We are looking for scientifically minded people to join our growing Hazard Communication team in either the UK or Turkey.

We are deliberately keeping the experience level for this role broad.

You might be an early-career regulatory professional who already has some experience of Safety Data Sheets, chemical classification, GHS/CLP, labelling or chemical regulatory affairs and is looking for the next step in your career. Alternatively, you may have a strong scientific background and transferable experience with the aptitude to develop into a Hazard Communication specialist.

You do not need to arrive knowing everything. We have an established technical training and development programme and can tailor your development according to your existing knowledge and experience.

For candidates who already have relevant Hazard Communication experience, the role can offer greater responsibility and independence from the outset.

The important things for us are strong scientific reasoning, attention to detail, curiosity, good judgement and the ability to learn and apply complex regulatory requirements.

What you'll be doing

Depending on your existing experience and development needs, your work will include:
  • Safety Data Sheet and label authoring for chemical products supplied into different global markets.
  • Hazard classification of substances and mixtures, applying GHS-based regulatory requirements including EU/GB CLP and requirements in other international jurisdictions.
  • Reviewing technical and compositional data and making informed classification and Hazard Communication decisions.
  • Supporting Poison Centre Notification (PCN) and related regulatory activities.
  • Reviewing SDS and other Hazard Communication documentation for regulatory compliance and quality.
  • Researching regulatory requirements and helping the team respond to technical and client questions.
  • Working with colleagues on international Hazard Communication projects and managed services.
  • Communicating with clients and other Yordas teams to understand requirements and deliver high-quality work.
  • Contributing to improvements in our technical processes, guidance, systems and tools.
As your knowledge and experience develop, there will be opportunities to take greater ownership of client relationships and projects, provide regulatory consultancy, undertake quality review, support and mentor colleagues, contribute to training and help develop new services.

What we're looking for

We are interested in candidates at different stages of their early regulatory careers, so we don't expect everyone to tick every box.

You will ideally have:
  • A Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in a scientific discipline, particularly Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Science, Biology, Biomedicine, Natural Sciences or a related subject; or equivalent relevant industry experience.
  • An analytical mindset and the ability to interpret scientific and technical information.
  • Excellent attention to detail and an appreciation of the importance of accuracy and consistency.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • The ability to manage changing priorities and organise your own workload.
  • Confidence working both independently and collaboratively within an international team.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to develop your technical knowledge.
Relevant experience would be an advantage and we would particularly like to hear from you if you have some experience in one or more of the following:
  • Safety Data Sheet authoring or review
  • GHS or CLP classification
  • Chemical or product labelling
  • Chemical regulatory affairs or product stewardship
  • REACH or CLP
  • Poison Centre Notifications / UFI
  • Dangerous Goods
  • Chemical compliance within industry
  • Regulatory or scientific consultancy
  • SDS authoring or regulatory software

What we can offer

Hazard Communication is a specialist field, and we don't expect people to arrive knowing every regulation or every market.

You'll receive structured training and support from experienced Hazard Communication professionals while working on real client projects. As you develop, you'll have opportunities to build expertise across global GHS requirements and pursue a career path that suits your strengths.

That could include becoming a technical specialist, moving further into consultancy and client management, managing projects, undertaking quality review, delivering training, developing new services or progressing into team leadership.

Yordas also offers a range of benefits depending on location, including professional development opportunities, generous holidays, flexible working and pension/medical benefits where applicable.

Application
If this sounds interesting but you're unsure whether your experience is quite at the right level, we'd still encourage you to apply. We're more interested in finding someone with the right scientific aptitude, regulatory mindset and potential than matching a rigid number of years' experience.

Please send your CV and covering letter to , outlining your relevant experience and why you're interested in developing your career in Hazard Communication.

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a hazard classification exercise. All information required to complete the exercise will be provided.

Yordas Group is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates from all backgrounds.

jobs.excerpt: The companyNorbert is building autonomous robots that deliver healthcare.
jobs.description:
The company

Norbert is building autonomous robots that deliver healthcare.

Our AI sensing platform mounts on mobile robots and does the work of a care team member—rounding on patients, capturing vitals without contact (FDA-cleared for pulse and respiratory rate, more in the pipeline), running assessments, documenting to the EMR, and escalating when something's wrong. Autonomously.

We're not building demos. We're deployed in real facilities today, monitoring hundreds of patients daily. We're solving one of healthcare's hardest problems: a global nursing shortage that will hit 40% by 2030.

We're a small, international team backed by top-tier VCs, with offices in Brooklyn and Paris. We ship things that matter.

The position

We're looking for a Signal Processing Engineer to join our algorithm and development team, working on remote vital sign monitoring from video. You'll develop and validate algorithms that extract clinical-grade physiological signals (heart rate, blood pressure, respiration) from camera data, working closely with computer vision engineers in our algorithm team.

What You'll Do:

  • Design and implement signal processing algorithms for extracting vital signs from video-based sensors (rPPG, rBP)
  • Develop real-time filtering, denoising, and feature extraction methods to achieve clinical-grade accuracy
  • Build validation pipelines comparing our video-based measurements against clinical reference devices (ECG, PPG, BP monitors)
  • Help design studies that ensure millisecond-level synchronization between video streams and reference sensors for accurate ground truth
  • Integrate with the computer vision pipeline (C++) to leverage multi-modal signal enhancement techniques
  • Architect cloud-based QA and automated verification systems for reproducible algorithm validation
  • Prototype algorithms in Python and C++ before deploying them on our production system

What We're Looking For:

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or related field (or PhD)
  • Strong fundamentals in digital signal processing, statistical methods, and real-time systems
  • Deep expertise in physiological signal processing (Radar, PPG, ECG, respiration, blood pressure)
  • Experience processing low-frequency physiological signals with challenging SNR characteristics
  • Proficiency in both Python (prototyping) and C++ (production integration)
  • Experience with spectral analysis, adaptive filtering, and time-domain methods for real-time applications
  • Ability to work independently, solve complex problems, and drive projects to completion
  • 5+ years industry experience developing signal processing algorithms for medical or physiological sensing applications (or equivalent with PhD)

Bonus Points:
