This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the monthly supply plan across our network of contract manufacturers and pack-out partners, working from demand down to purchase orders
  • Take over supplier relationships directly and build a negotiation program on top of them: pricing tiers, capacity commitments, and quarterly business reviews backed by scorecards on delivery, yield, quality, and cost
  • Publish and own our fully burdened cost per unit, partner with Finance to track it, and find the levers to bring it down through smarter allocation and procurement
  • Build and run demand planning and a monthly S&OP cycle that gets Finance, Marketing, and Retail committed to one number
  • Design and de-risk our logistics and 3PL network, including routing and freight decisions that affect landed cost
  • Manage and develop your team, staying hands-on in the model while building the leadership the function needs as scope grows
  • Move our planning process off spreadsheets and onto a system built for it

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 8-12 years in CPG supply chain, with at least 3 years owning a function or a major end to end scope
  • Has run an asset-light contract manufacturing network: allocating volume across multiple co-manufacturers or co-packers, working within MOQs and capacity ceilings, and managing long lead times
  • Has a strong track record negotiating supplier agreements directly
  • Has owned a cost-per-unit or COGS number and can tell us the baseline, what they did, and the result
  • Has built a supply plan themselves in a model: net requirements, safety stock, on-hand, and open POs
  • Has run or stood up an S&OP process and gotten cross-functional teams to commit to a number, including an unpopular one

Approach to the role:

  • You see a working system as a foundation, not a finish line, and you're excited to build on top of it rather than around it
  • You stay in the model yourself and bring recommendations, not just data
  • You're decisive with incomplete information. You make the call, name the assumption you're carrying, and say what would change your mind
  • You're commercially aggressive and relationally durable: you push hard on price and still get the call answered when you need a favor six months later
  • You communicate with brevity. Whether it's Finance, the CEO, or a cross-functional partner, they get what they need and nothing extra.
  • You move with urgency and low ego, and you don't need a lot of infrastructure to get going

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $180,000-$200,000 plus incentive compensationdepending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

As you become familiar with the systems, datasets and business processes, there will be opportunities to take on more complex development, automation, integrations and analytical projects.

SQL & Database Support

  • Handle recurring data imports, exports and routine data processes.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to independently investigate existing reports, databases and processes.

  • Ability to work confidently with repetitive and detail-oriented tasks while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage recurring responsibilities reliably.
  • Ability to take ownership of tasks and follow processes through to completion.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.

Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Why do we ask for a video?

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

  • How you communicate and connect with people.
  • How you present yourself professionally.
  • Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Think of it as your personal trailer. One great video means we can pitch you for multiple roles and get you in front of the right employers, faster.

Heads up: Some clients watch your video directly, so make it one you'd be proud to have represent you. This is your highlight reel—make it count!

Step 3 – Let's Actually Talk

A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.

Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Step 6 – Showtime

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way—with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.

Step 7 – The Verdict

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

jobs.excerpt: This role is offered at either the Program Officer or the Senior Program Officer level.
jobs.description:
This role is offered at either the Program Officer or the Senior Program Officer level. The salary range covers multiple seniority steps across these levels, and where an offer falls will depend on your experience and performance during the selection process. See "Levels and compensation" below. We may be open to hiring two people in this round.
To apply, please click "Apply Now" to respond to the initial questions in the application form and attach your CV. We ask that you spend no more than 90 minutes preparing your responses to the prompts.
Application Deadline: Sunday, October 11,2026, end of day (23:59) Anywhere on Earth (UTC-12:00).
Note Before Applying: We invite anyone who is interested in this role to apply, and will assess applications primarily on anonymized responses to the application prompts, so please ensure they represent your fit for the position well. We also ask candidates to attach their CV: it will not be scored, but we will use it later in the process for verification. Please do not include a cover letter, photograph or headshot, or any personal information not relevant to the role (including marital status, age, identity traits). Please also do not ask staff involved in the hiring process to meet with you — to ensure fairness, such requests will be declined.
Contact: Please email if you have any questions.

About the Position

Rethink Priorities' Animal Welfare Department advances evidence-based and reason-driven change for animals. Within it, the Neglected Animals Program works on animals that are overlooked relative to how many of them there are — farmed invertebrates and wild animals. These are populations counted in the hundreds of billions and upwards, almost entirely outside the scope of existing animal welfare protections, and receiving a tiny fraction of the attention directed at farmed vertebrates.
We are looking for a Program Officer or Senior Program Officer to take a substantial share of this program's work and run with it, primarily focused on terrestrial invertebrate welfare — both farmed and wild.
The program's bottleneck is finding out which questions matter, getting them investigated by the most appropriate talent, and ensuring the analysis is acted upon. Sometimes that means doing the research in-house. But often it means finding and managing the right contractor, or convening the handful of organizations working on a particular problem.

Where your time would go. Roughly half your time on farmed terrestrial invertebrates and half on wild ones. The balance will shift as opportunities move. The wild side of this work is at an earlier stage of strategic development than the farmed side. In the future, this role could expand to cover other wild animals.

Key responsibilities and the types of tasks involved in the role

~35% Analysis and intervention evaluation — decision-oriented analysis that lets aligned funders and organizations make better calls.
  • Run a shallow intervention review: go from a loosely specified idea to a defensible recommendation on whether it is worth pursuing, within a fixed time budget.
  • Identify and interview experts on questions that academic and gray literature cannot answer.
  • Conduct analysis of a production system — its economics, cost, and whether it can plausibly be commercially viable at scale — or write the specification for a contractor to build one and quality-assure what they deliver.
  • Analyze published financial disclosures to understand a company's or a sector's trajectory, rather than relying on media reports or press releases.
~30% Commissioning and overseeing external work — commissioning work, convening the field, and incubating new efforts where nothing suitable exists.
  • Scope, commission and manage an external contractor or consultancy, including in a region where we currently have no in-house presence — and decide when to stop work that isn't delivering.
~25% Stakeholder engagement and coordination — building the relationships that let well-informed decisions actually get made.
  • Help organize a coordination event that brings together the organizations working on a shared problem, and follow through on what was agreed.
  • Write and present an update for a funder on what a project has achieved, what it has not, and what you would do differently.
  • Present your work at a conference and build relationships with others working in the field.
~10% Strategy and opportunity identification — Bringing forward new opportunities, and honestly assessing which of the program's current bets are not working.
  • Take an idea that someone has floated, evaluate it honestly, and either run with it or kill it.
  • Exercise judgment about information sensitivity — some of this program's work requires discretion about what is shared, with whom, and when.

What sorts of topics you would work on

To get a sense of the kind of question you would investigate, see the executive summaries of:
  • Investments into insect farming
  • Can black soldier fly larvae (BSFL) producers displace fishmeal?
  • Database of near-term interventions for wild animals
  • Forecasting farmed animal numbers in 2033
You are also welcome to browse our full research database.
Note that not all our work in this space is openly published.

Levels and compensation

The salary range ($79,000 – $98,500 USD pre-tax) covers more than one seniority step. Toward the upper end of the range we would expect more of the following:
  • Autonomy — running projects with minimal oversight, and taking the initiative to learn tasks you have not done before.
  • Judgment we lean on — program leadership consulting you on which projects are worth taking on at all, not just how to execute them.
  • A track record of moving decision-makers — analysis aimed at changing what someone outside your own organization actually does, where you elicited their needs early and shaped the output around them.
  • Independent stakeholder relationships — being trusted as a counterpart in your own right by people outside RP.
Toward the lower end of the range we would expect strong analytical capability and clear evidence of potential, with less of a track record behind it — we would expect to coach you on commissioning external work and on building relationships in the field. Toward the upper end we would expect you to arrive already able to do both, and we would lean on your judgment about which projects are worth taking on at all. You do not need to signal which end you think you fit; we assess that from your answers.
This role does not currently include line management of RP staff, and would not involve running hiring rounds or performance reviews — though you would manage contractors and external partners. At the Senior Program Officer level, line management responsibilities may be introduced in future.

What We Are Looking For

Essential criteria

  • Analytical judgment under time pressure. You can take a vague but important question, scope it sensibly, identify critical assumptions, choose a defensible method, and reach a usable answer by a deadline — rather than an exhaustive answer late.
  • Getting work done through other people. You have specified a piece of work for someone else to deliver — a contractor, consultant, agency, or a team outside your own — held them to it, and formed your own view about whether what came back was good enough to act on.
  • Quantitative reasoning. You are comfortable building, interrogating and explaining simple models. You can produce quick back-of-the-envelope calculations, and you are comfortable articulating confidence in assumptions or beliefs using numbers as well as words.
  • Clear written communication for decision-makers. You can explain a chain of reasoning — premises, inferences, and where it might be wrong — to an intelligent reader who is not a specialist and who does not have much time.
  • Comfort with deep uncertainty. You can give a caveated but genuinely decision-useful answer with transparent reasoning, instead of waiting for evidence that will not arrive.
  • Sound judgment about sensitive information. You can be trusted to hold information carefully and to work out for yourself what should and should not be shared.
  • Pragmatism and flexibility. The program's priorities move. You are comfortable being redeployed onto a different problem, and comfortable abandoning your own idea when the evidence turns.
  • Truthseeking and research ethics. A steadfast commitment to following the evidence, including when it undercuts a conclusion you or we would prefer.
  • Commitment to the mission — you care about improving the welfare of animals who are neglected relative to their numbers, and you are open to focusing your career on terrestrial invertebrates, building expertise and networks in the field.

Desirable criteria

  • Techno-economic analysis, unit-economics modeling, or industry / market analysis — in any sector.
  • Reading and interpreting company financial statements, statutory accounts, or investor disclosures.
  • Knowledge of invertebrate biology or entomology, in either a production or an ecological context.
  • Knowledge of agricultural production systems, animal feed, crop protection, or waste management.
  • Working experience in low- and middle-income country contexts, particularly Sub-Saharan Africa or Southeast Asia.
  • Grantmaking, due diligence, procurement, or contract management experience.
  • Reporting to funders, grant-makers, or a board.
  • Convening or facilitating processes involving several organizations with differing interests.
  • Skill with strategic decision-making tools (stakeholder mapping, scenario analysis, SWOT).
  • Proficiency with R or Python.
  • Experience working in or volunteering for the animal advocacy movement.
  • Working proficiency in a language other than English, particularly one spoken in a major agricultural producing region.
  • Working constructively with external parties whose interests and priorities do not fully align with your own.
  • Overseeing a project from conception to delivery in a remote, distributed team.
  • Comfortable working in an AI-forward workplace
We expect that even highly qualified applicants will not meet all of these criteria. We encourage you to apply even if you do not have some of these skills, knowledge and experiences.

What We Offer

Compensation

We offer an annual salary between the following ranges for a full-time Program Officer and Senior Program Officer positions, prorated for part-time work:
  • $79,000 – $98,500 USD pre-tax
  • £61,000 – £76,600 GBP pre-tax
  • €71,000 – €89,350 EUR pre-tax
The exact salary will be based on the candidate's prior relevant experience and corresponding title level, and calculated using RP's salary algorithm. Compensation is not restricted to the currencies listed above. To ensure fairness across the entire organization, RP does not negotiate salaries.

Other Benefits

  • Opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, high-impact organization — our research is used by key decision makers who influence the distribution of hundreds of millions of charitable dollars.
  • Remote-first environment, including flexible work hours and schedule.
  • Comprehensive global benefits program, including statutory benefits as required by local law, and supplemental benefits specific to each country (varies by location).
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) and unpaid leave, including:
    • Unlimited vacation with a minimum number of required statutory days off
    • "Mandated" 3 weeks total mid- and end-year organization-wide breaks
    • Unlimited (within reason) personal and sick paid and unpaid leave
    • Parental leave — at least 4–9 months of a combination of paid and unpaid leave, available prior to and/or during the first 2 years after a child's birth or adoption
    • Other paid and unpaid leave (e.g., bereavement)
  • Technology stipend of $2,000 USD equivalent every 3 years for work and office equipment.
  • AI tools budget of $40 USD equivalent monthly.
  • Learning opportunities, including workshops/training sessions and 10% of work time dedicated to professional and personal development.
  • Paid work trips, including one annual all-staff Mega Team Retreat and relevant conferences.
  • Virtual co-working spaces, including a private Rethink Priorities Focusmate group.
  • RP Peer Support Program for New Employees.
  • Other benefits at the discretion of RP Leadership.
  • A caring team that values respectful work relations and a healthy work-life balance.
  • Low administrative bureaucracy.
  • We don't provide snacks, but we could mail you a box of Oreos if you want!

Additional Information

  • Work Environment and Visa Sponsorship: This role is fully remote and we are able to legally hire in many countries. In certain cases, we may be able to provide visa sponsorship to the US or UK and help candidates relocate. If you have questions about whether we can hire or provide visa sponsorship in another country and if this will influence your decision about applying, please contact before submitting your application.
  • Time Zones and Working Hours: While we welcome applicants from all time zones, most of the Animal Welfare Department works between US Eastern Time and Central European Time. Your regular working schedule should ideally overlap with 14:00–16:00 UTC on weekdays.
  • Full time position preferred: We have a preference for candidates able to work on a full-time basis, but are open to candidates who can work at least 30 hours a week.
  • Travel: Travel to work-related events is likely to be important for having impact in this role. We would ideally like candidates to be able to attend 4–6 events per year — a mix of RP staff retreats, conferences, coordination events and industry events — usually requiring international flights.
We expect much of the value of this role may come building networks, identifying and overseeing contractors, and insights from conversations that would be hard to uncover from desk research alone. If travel at this frequency would be difficult for you, we would still encourage you to apply, and to contact to discuss — but please note that you would want to explore how you could deliver the network-building and oversight parts of the role by other means.
  • Language: Professional level of English language is required for all roles at Rethink Priorities.
  • Extension requests: We will try to accommodate extension requests that are made before the deadline and are up to three (3) days. We generally cannot accommodate extension requests made after the application deadline, or are longer than 3 days, and cannot accept late submissions to ensure fairness to other applicants.
  • Application materials: All application materials must be submitted in English language; otherwise, we will not be able to evaluate your candidacy.
  • Inclusivity and fairness: RP is committed to building an inclusive, equitable, and supportive community for you to thrive and do your best work. Please don't hesitate to apply for a role regardless of your age, gender identity/expression, political identity, personal preferences, physical abilities, veteran status, neurodiversity or any other background. We provide reasonable accommodations and benefits, including, for example, flexible work schedules and locations, mental health coverage through medical benefits (as available), as well as technology budgets and professional development time that can be used, for example, to purchase assistive technology or engage in job coaching.
  • Accessibility: We're committed to running an inclusive and accessible hiring process. We warmly invite you to reach out to with any questions or accessibility requests such as chat box use during interviews.
  • Hiring Software: We use Pinpoint for our recruitment and hiring processes and all of the email correspondence is done via Pinpoint. We encourage you to add the Pinpoint domain (@pinpoint.email and @pinpointhq.com) ) to your trusted contacts and/or check your 'spam', 'promotions' and 'updates' folders, if you don't hear from us within the expected timeframe.
  • Past applicant policy: We may be able to accelerate your job application if you have applied to the same or a similar role within RP or a similar institution and advanced within the last two years. Please get in touch stating which role you applied to, when, and to which stage you were advanced at which organization if you would like to be considered for this possibility.
  • Consideration for other roles: We sometimes identify strong candidates in one hiring round whose skills are well matched to other roles within the department. If you are not selected for this position, we may contact you to ask whether you would like to be considered for a related opening, should one arise. You do not need to indicate interest at the application stage.
  • Other: Visit our Career webpage if you'd like to know more about our hiring process, culture, and what working at RP is like.

Our Hiring Process

There are 4 evaluation stages. Only candidates who meet the bar at a given stage proceed. We aim to complete each stage's assessment within two to three weeks, so you learn quickly whether you are progressing.
Stage 1 — Application Prompts. A short set of written prompts (target: no more than 90 minutes total). We score anonymized responses for: analytical judgment; ability to get work done through others and engage stakeholders; relevant knowledge and experience; and motivation for this work.
Stage 2 — Paid Skills Assessment. A standardised, time-boxed paid task that mimics the actual job. You will also be invited to share an existing piece of written work and, if you have one, a data or model file. This is optional and candidates who do not have suitable material are not disadvantaged.
Stage 3 — Interview. Questions across the skills and experience the role requires. Most questions are typically sent in advance; occasionally we will name the topic but not the question. Candidates invited to this stage will have the chance to ask us about the role, the department and RP.
Stage 4 — Reference Checks. We ask two references about your work, probing independent execution and reliability in particular.

About Rethink Priorities

Founded in 2018, Rethink Priorities (RP) is a think-and-do tank. Through research and action, the organization improves the lives of humans and animals—both now and in the future.
We work to identify solutions, mobilize resources, and empower our team and others to address some of the world's most pressing problems. Our team conducts rigorous research across animal welfare, climate change, global health, international development, and other important and neglected areas. Our operations experts help high-impact organizations to improve efficiency and achieve meaningful results.
RP works as all of the following:
  1. A consultancy doing commissioned work in response to demands from organizations doing high-impact work
  2. A research institute driven by research agendas we set according to our own priorities.
  3. A think tank aiming to inform public policy to improve the world.
  4. An accelerator, incubator, and base for priority projects.
Accomplishments include:
  • Bringing attention to neglected issues, such as lead exposure, fungal diseases, and shrimp welfare.
  • Increasing the collective impact of advocates across each field in which we work through strategic coordination.
  • Investigating potential interventions and identifying the most cost-effective options. In 2025, our research influenced tens of millions of dollars in foundation grants.
  • Creating practical tools for philanthropists to compare resource allocations across different species and cause areas and to build giving portfolios despite uncertainties.
  • Providing organizations with data to inform their decisions. For example, we have conducted surveys on perceptions of existential risks, AI, effective giving, and other topics.
  • Providing fiscal sponsorship and operational support to ensure that high-impact initiatives in areas like AI safety and animal welfare can launch and grow effectively.
  • Donor Compass — a cross-cause fund tool to guide philanthropic giving.
We welcome you to review our research database and our latest annual report.
Contact: Please email if you have any questions.

jobs.title: Open sollicitatie The Safety Network
jobs.excerpt: Staat jouw ideale vacature er niet tussen?  Wil jij werken in een organisatie waar veiligheid centraal staat en waar je echt impact kunt maken?
jobs.description:
Staat jouw ideale vacature er niet tussen?

Wil jij werken in een organisatie waar veiligheid centraal staat en waar je echt impact kunt maken? Maar zie je op dit moment geen vacature die precies aansluit bij jouw ervaring, ambities of interesses? Dan nodigen we je van harte uit om een open sollicitatie te sturen.

Binnen The Safety Network zijn we altijd op zoek naar professionals die willen bijdragen aan een veiligere werkomgeving. Of je nu werkzaam bent in de praktijk, op kantoor of in een specialistische adviesrol: we maken graag kennis met mensen die verantwoordelijkheid nemen, betrokken zijn en zichzelf willen blijven ontwikkelen.


Werken aan veiligheid met impact

The Safety Network is een groep van gespecialiseerde bedrijven die organisaties in heel Nederland ondersteunen op het gebied van (brand)veiligheid, arbo, training, consultancy en toezicht.

Onder andere de volgende bedrijven maken deel uit van The Safety Network:

· TSA Safety Services

· Alert

· Inprevo

· DeltaSafe

· S2N

· All Prevent

· Jonkman Opleidingen

· Spider

· Acrentis

Samen werken we aan één gezamenlijke missie: organisaties helpen om veiliger en gezonder te werken.


Voor welke functies kun je open solliciteren?

Binnen onze bedrijven zijn regelmatig mogelijkheden in uiteenlopende functies, zoals:

  • Brandwacht / Heetwerkwacht / Veiligheidswacht
  • Middelbaar Veiligheidskundige (MVK)

· Hoger Veiligheidskundige (HVK)

· Trainer of instructeur

· Consultant

· Planner

· Recruiter of HR-professional

· Marketing en communicatie

  • Administratieve en ondersteunende functies

Ook als jouw functie hier niet tussen staat, ontvangen we graag jouw open sollicitatie.

Dit breng jij mee

Misschien weet je al precies welke richting je op wilt. Misschien ben je nog aan het ontdekken waar jouw talenten het beste tot hun recht komen. In beide gevallen maken we graag kennis met mensen die energie krijgen van verantwoordelijkheid, ontwikkeling en samenwerken.

· Betrokkenheid en eigenaarschap

  • Oog voor kwaliteit en een zorgvuldige manier van werken
  • Nieuwsgierigheid en de motivatie om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen
  • De wens om samen te werken en kennis te delen
  • Een ondernemende instelling en het vermogen om kansen te zien
  • De ambitie om bij te dragen aan een veiligere en gezondere werkomgeving

Of je nu ervaring hebt in de praktijk, op kantoor, in advies of in een ondersteunende rol: als jij denkt dat jouw kennis en persoonlijkheid passen bij onze organisatie, dan horen we graag van je.


Wat kun je van ons verwachten?

Werken binnen The Safety Network betekent werken in een organisatie waar ondernemerschap, vakmanschap en samenwerking centraal staan. Je komt terecht in een omgeving waarin mensen verantwoordelijkheid nemen, kennis delen en elkaar helpen om iedere dag beter te worden.

The Safety Network bestaat uit een groep gespecialiseerde bedrijven die ieder hun eigen expertise hebben op het gebied van veiligheid, gezondheid, training en consultancy. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan TSA Safety Services, Alert, Inprevo, DeltaSafe, S2N, All Prevent, Jonkman Opleidingen, Spider en Acrentis.

Of je nu aan het begin van je carrière staat of al ruime ervaring hebt: we bieden je de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en jouw talenten verder uit te bouwen. Dankzij de diversiteit aan bedrijven, functies en specialismen zijn er volop mogelijkheden om je kennis te verdiepen, nieuwe richtingen te verkennen en door te groeien binnen onze organisatie.

  • Een marktconform salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden
  • Opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, zowel vakinhoudelijk als persoonlijk
  • Doorgroeikansen binnen één van onze bedrijven of juist over de grenzen van bedrijven heen
  • Betrokken collega’s die graag kennis delen en voor elkaar klaarstaan
  • Een informele en professionele werkomgeving met korte lijnen
  • Werk dat ertoe doet en zichtbaar bijdraagt aan een veiligere en gezondere werkomgeving

Bij The Safety Network krijg je niet alleen een baan, maar vooral de kans om mee te bouwen aan een ambitieuze organisatie waarin jouw kennis, ideeën en initiatief worden gewaardeerd.


Over The Safety Network

The Safety Network brengt gespecialiseerde bedrijven samen die elk hun eigen expertise hebben, maar dezelfde ambitie delen: organisaties ondersteunen op het gebied van veiligheid, gezondheid en ontwikkeling.

Door onze krachten te bundelen bieden we collega’s niet alleen een uitdagende functie, maar ook de mogelijkheid om zich verder te ontwikkelen binnen een brede en groeiende organisatie.


Enthousiast geworden?

Staat jouw ideale vacature er op dit moment niet tussen, maar denk je dat jij goed past binnen The Safety Network? Stuur ons dan jouw open sollicitatie.

Vertel ons wie je bent, wat je zoekt en waar jouw kracht ligt. We kijken graag samen waar jij het beste tot je recht komt, nu of in de toekomst.

Highlights

Staat jouw ideale vacature er nog niet tussen? Stuur een open sollicitatie en ontdek waar jij het verschil kunt maken binnen The Safety Network.

jobs.excerpt: About RecareAs one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy.
jobs.description:
About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

What to expect as our Tech Lead (Agent Frontend) (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We’ll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you’ll have the day off.

In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Tech Lead (Agent Frontend) (m/w/d):

You will take end-to-end technical ownership of the Recare Agent – our AI-native interface that orchestrates capabilities like Voice and Extract+Docs into reliable, compliant workflows for hospital environments. This is a highly visible product area where engineering decisions directly define user experience, reliability, and trust in AI-driven healthcare workflows.

  • You ownthe technical direction of the Recare Agent – from architecture decisions to roadmap execution and delivery predictability.

  • You leadthe team as the technical backbone and escalation point, ensuring clarity, speed, and quality in execution.

  • You designand evolvethe agent architecture, especially around agentic UI patterns and orchestration logic.

  • You enablethe team through hands-on mentorship, code reviews, and removing blockers fast.

  • You drivereliability, performance, observability, and security across all agent workflows in a highly sensitive healthcare context.

  • You buildand shipfrontend systems using React and TypeScript, with a strong focus on scalable, maintainable architecture.

  • You collaborateclosely with Product, Design, and QA to sharpen scope, manage trade-offs, and ensure predictable delivery.

  • You ensureproduction readiness through clear runbooks, stable releases, and measurable SLAs.

How we build:

We use a modern frontend stack to build and ship a highly interactive, AI-powered agent experience that must be fast, reliable, and safe in production healthcare environments.

  • React and TypeScript

  • Apollo (GraphQL proxy layer; REST-based backend services)

  • HeroUI with styled-components

  • Storybook (component-driven development)

  • Webpack 5 (with parts gradually migrating to Vite / SWC)

  • CircleCI (Jest, Cypress, visual regression testing)

jobs.title: Director of AI
jobs.excerpt: Director of AIWho is Ludia Consulting? Ludia Consulting is one of the fastest-growing and innovative consulting firms in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain, Customer Engagement, and Power Platform.
jobs.description:
Director of AI

Who is Ludia Consulting?

Ludia Consulting is one of the fastest-growing and innovative consulting firms in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain, Customer Engagement, and Power Platform. We are looking for a team member committed to helping others and their communities while also growing professionally as part of our Ludia family.

We are not just a traditional organization; we are driven to help our partners and clients while delivering value every day. Our team members are encouraged to grow by sharing their knowledge and experience through community-driven channels, including local non-profit organizations.

About Ludia Labs

Ludia Labs is our AI innovation studio. It is where we build the AI accelerators, intelligent agents, and Microsoft Copilot solutions that we put to work for our customers and inside our own business. We have a direct line to Microsoft Engineering and FastTrack, and we ground everything we build in our Dynamics 365 and Physical Operations experience.

The Role

Reports To: Chief Operations Officer

Responsible For: the Ludia Labs AI engineering team, and the firm's AI policy, platform register, and AI budget

As Director of AI, you lead how Ludia uses AI, inside our own walls and in what we deliver to customers. You own the internal AI strategy that brings intelligent agents to every part of the business, the policy and governance that keep those agents safe, the budget that pays for them, and the Ludia Labs accelerators that put the same capability in our customers' hands. We care about AI that reaches production and gets used.You are also responsible for all Customer AI Implementation projects.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You know Dynamics 365 cold, because nearly every agent and accelerator we build sits on top of it, and you are comfortable in the code, the architecture, and the standards that keep what we ship reliable. You set the bar for how Ludia builds AI, and you give the team the tools to move faster.

You are also a human-first thinker. You believe AI should get more out of people rather than replace them: pair human reasoning and judgment with agents that handle the rest, and people do their best work. You will be Ludia's advocate for that future inside the firm, and you will help our customers picture it and get there too.

You work with the leaders of Operations, Delivery, Sales, Marketing, and Talent to turn ideas into automation the business can measure. You meet with the CEO monthly and with the AI Steering Committee quarterly, and you run the AI function in between. Security, governance, and responsible AI stay central to everything you ship.

What Success Looks Like

Every responsibility below ties back to one of these measures. You and the CEO review them each quarter.

In your first 90 days

  • Ludia's AI Policy and its platform register are current, adopted by the leadership team, and in daily use. Every AI platform is listed with the teams approved to use it and the highest data class it may hold.
  • One internal agent is in production with named users, a named owner, and a measured result.
  • AI spend is visible. Every seat, license, and consumption line is tracked by platform and reported to the CFO monthly.
  • Ludia's AI development standards and definition of done are written and applied to every active build.

In your first year

  • An agent is in production in each of Sales, Delivery, Operations, Marketing, and Talent, and each one reports its hours saved or revenue touched every month.
  • Adoption is measured, not assumed: monthly active users per agent, and the share of team members using an approved AI tool each week.
  • AI spend lands within the approved budget, and every pilot receives a written kill-or-scale decision within 90 days of launch.
  • At least two Ludia Labs accelerators are versioned, documented, and deployed on customer projects.
  • Every AI incident is reported inside the window the policy sets, and the quarterly register review runs on time, every quarter.
  • Every team has completed hands-on AI enablement, and the monthly demonstration forum runs without you as the presenter.

Customer Facing

  • Maintain a billable utilization target of 50%, tracked monthly.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the AI products and its customers, including escalations and account health.
  • Respond to customer issues promptly and see them through to resolution.
  • Share customer feedback with delivery and leadership to improve the offering.
  • Mentor junior consultants and contribute to delivery standards for AI related delivery.
  • Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts and partner with Sales to shape follow-on work, managed services, and roadmap engagements specific to AI.
  • •Represent Ludia in executive briefings, steering committees, and quarterly business reviews.

Essential Functions

AI strategy, policy, governance, and cost

  • Own Ludia's internal AI strategy and roadmap, and keep it tied to how the firm is growing and how our people actually work.
  • Own Ludia's AI Policy and its amendment cycle. Keep it written by what a system can do and what it can touch, not by product name, so it survives a tool change.
  • Run the AI platform register: which platforms we run under Company agreement, which teams may use each one, and the highest data class each may hold. Lead the quarterly register review, and take any capability change (a tool that can do more or reach further) through approval before it is switched on.
  • Sit on the AI Steering Committee and operate the approval matrix, so everyday assisted work moves in a day and anything autonomous, or acting in a client's production environment, gets executive sign-off.
  • Own the AI budget: seats and licenses, Copilot and Foundry consumption, and model costs. Report spend by platform to the CFO monthly, set consumption guardrails per agent, and retire what is not earning its cost.
  • Own AI security for internal solutions: identity and access through Entra ID, data residency, access controls, audit trails, prompt-injection defense, and content safety. Work with leadership to keep Ludia's data and our clients' data protected.
  • Run the AI incident process with a named AI System Owner in each function, so every system has an owner and no one reviews their own work.

Technical leadership and AI development standards

  • Stay hands-on. Build agents yourself, set the standard for what good looks like, and review the work the team ships.
  • Define Ludia's AI development standards: architecture and design patterns, prompt and grounding practices, evaluation and testing, security, and a clear definition of done for an agent. Every agent passes acceptance evaluation before it is released.
  • Build and maintain the foundation that speeds the team up: shared SDKs and templates, reusable components, RAG pipelines over Azure AI Search, evaluation harnesses, CI/CD, and observability, using Azure DevOps or GitHub.
  • Stand up the operational backbone for AI in production: telemetry and monitoring, application lifecycle management (ALM), human-in-the-loop controls, and responsible-AI guardrails.
  • Choose the development platform (Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, the Microsoft Agent Framework) and make sensible build-versus-buy calls. Ground the work in Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Dataverse, so agents work with the systems our clients run on.

Agentic innovation and automation

  • Work with team owners in Operations, Delivery, Sales, Marketing, and Talent to surface ideas for automation, then rank them by value and feasibility.
  • Run discovery that turns real business pain points into agent solutions and keep a live backlog of the best opportunities.
  • Pilot, measure, and scale what works, and kill what does not. Every pilot gets a named owner, defined users, a success measure, and a kill-or-scale decision within 90 days.

Ludia Labs accelerators

  • Build and support the Ludia Labs accelerators and AI tools that bring repeatable, reliable AI to our customers.
  • Shape the AI and agent strategy for the industries we know best (field service, operations, and Finance & Supply Chain) and tie it to our accelerator and IP roadmap.
  • Package accelerators so others can reuse them: version, document, and support each one so delivery teams deploy with confidence.

Educate, mentor, and lead adoption

  • Raise AI literacy across the whole organization: training, office hours, hands-on sessions, and the monthly demonstration forum.
  • Mentor engineers and consultants on agent development and our AI standards, and grow the next set of AI leaders here.
  • Lead adoption so people get more out of their day working alongside AI, and track it: who is using what, how often, and to what result.

Working across the business

  • Bring credible AI expertise into pre-sales and customer conversations, including how Ludia governs its own AI, and keep the handoff from sales to delivery clean.
  • Share what you are learning through demos, internal sessions, blogs, and the occasional white paper. Extend it to Dynamics for Good, where we put AI to work on community and mission impact.

Skills & Competencies

Required

  • 10+ years in AI, data, or solution architecture roles, with at least 3 of those years leading an AI team, practice, or capability.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • A track record of shipping AI agents and copilots into production, with real users and measurable value behind them.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of Dynamics 365, the platform our agents and accelerators sit on: how Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, and Finance & Supply Chain work, plus the Power Platform and Dataverse underneath.
  • You still write code and build agents yourself (C#/.NET, Python, or TypeScript), and you can set the patterns, standards, and review bar that everyone else follows.
  • Hands-on command of the Microsoft AI stack: Copilot Studio (agents, topics, actions, connectors, plugins), Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility and declarative agents, Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Foundry), Azure OpenAI, and Azure AI Search across vector, hybrid, and semantic retrieval.
  • Fluency with agentic patterns: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), grounding, multi-agent orchestration, evaluation for groundedness and traceability, human-in-the-loop, and telemetry. You have used Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or the Microsoft Agent Framework, and open protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A).
  • Experience owning an AI acceptable-use policy or governance program, and an AI budget, in a company that handles client data. You can explain a platform decision to a CFO and a data-handling answer to a client's security team.
  • Real ownership of AI security and responsible AI: access controls, data residency, audit trails, prompt-injection defense, content safety, and governance through Entra ID, DLP, environments, and ALM.
  • Working knowledge of the data foundation for enterprise AI: Microsoft Fabric, Dataverse, and Power Platform.
  • A human-first leadership style: you communicate well with executives, you lead change, and you get the most out of people by pairing them well with technology.
  • A talent for teaching and growing people: you can run enablement, mentor engineers, and raise AI literacy across a services organization.

Preferred

  • Experience in our Physical Operations verticals (heavy equipment, energy, manufacturing, engineering & construction, professional services) and with Dynamics 365, especially F&SC, Customer Engagement, and Field Service.
  • Microsoft AI certifications, especially AI Transformation Leader (AB-731) and Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect Expert (AB-100).
  • Experience building reusable accelerators, IP, or marketplace solutions.
  • Familiarity with ISO/IEC 42001 or a comparable AI management standard, and with the US state and EU AI rules that apply to a services firm.

Desirable

  • AI Agent Builder Associate (AB-620) or Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102).
  • Ability to travel occasionally within the United States for Microsoft, client, or industry events.

Benefits / Why Ludia

  • 100% Remote
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Companywide time off at the end of the year
  • Full health, vision, and dental benefits
  • 401K
  • Work directly with Microsoft's engineering and FastTrack teams
  • Opportunity to build and lead Ludia's AI capability and the Ludia Labs accelerator portfolio
  • ...and more!

Ludia Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants receive consideration for employment regardless of their race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, or status with regard to public assistance.

Who we are

Releaf Dispensary Ltd is a leading medical cannabis clinic committed to providing high-quality, safe, and effective cannabis-based treatments. Headquartered in the UK, we aim to enhance the quality of life for our patients through innovative solutions and outstanding patient service.

We’re a fast-growing team of passionate professionals on a mission to put patients back in control of their health journey. We’ve seen first-hand how alternative treatments can change lives, and we’re proud to be at the forefront of that change.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for sharp, detail-oriented SEO Content Writers to join our busy, growing Marketing Department, people who can turn complex topics into clear, accurate content that ranks well and that readers genuinely trust.

The ideal candidate is a strong writer with a real interest in health and a good feel for SEO: how people search, what they’re really looking for, and how to write content that answers it. You’ll care about accuracy and detail because this is content that people rely on, where getting it right matters.

Reporting to the Head of Content, you’ll make sure everything you produce is high quality, written in Releaf’s tone of voice, optimised for search, and compliant with the regulations that apply to our industry. This is a hands-on writing role with full training and support, but we’re looking for a self-starter who can manage their own workflow, work from a brief, and hit deadlines without close supervision.

Key responsibilities

  • Content Creation: Write clear, accurate and engaging content across Releaf’s channels, including website pages and copy, blog articles, patient stories and PR pieces, optimised both to rank in search and to genuinely help readers.
  • Research & Briefs: Work from content briefs, researching each subject thoroughly so that what you produce is accurate, well-sourced, and trustworthy.
  • On-page Optimisation: Apply on-page SEO best practice as you write, including search intent, headings, metadata, internal linking and natural use of target keywords.
  • Tone of Voice: Write consistently in Releaf’s tone of voice, adapting your style to suit the channel while keeping the brand voice intact.
  • Accuracy & Trust: Produce content that reflects genuine expertise, authority and trust (E-E-A-T), citing reputable sources and reflecting current guidance.
  • Editorial Quality: Self-edit to a high standard for clarity and grammar, and act on feedback from the Head of Content.
  • Compliance: Make sure everything you write meets the regulatory and compliance requirements that apply to our sector, working closely with the team to stay within the rules.
  • Keeping Content Fresh: Update and improve existing content to maintain accuracy and search performance over time.
  • AI Search Visibility: Write in a way that helps Releaf get surfaced and cited across modern search and AI tools, with guidance from the team.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the Head of Content and the wider team to get content planned, written and published.

What you’ll need

Essential

  • 2-3 years of experience writing SEO content, in-house, at an agency or freelance.
  • Native-level written English, with excellent grammar and a sharp eye for detail.
  • Experience writing in healthcare, lifestyle, wellness or another regulated, high-trust subject.
  • Comfortable managing your own workload and meeting deadlines.

Desirable

  • Familiarity with SEO tools (such as Ahrefs, Semrush or Google Search Console) and a CMS (such as DATO, Sanity, etc).
  • Awareness of how AI search and LLMs are changing the way people find information.
  • An understanding of content compliance in a regulated sector.
  • A solid understanding of on-page SEO and search intent.

Reporting and KPIs

This is a high-performance writing role, and we are clear from the start about what good looks like. We look at two things: the quality of your work before it goes live, and how it performs once it is published. Output and turnaround targets are agreed with the Head of Content and based on the length and complexity of the work.

We’re looking for someone who is excited to join a busy growing organisation - our team culture is based on support and respect and we take a proactive approach to employee progression and development. The ideal candidate for this role will be happy to roll their sleeves up and can take ownership of this role. In return, we offer flexible working; personalised training and development; private health insurance, Employee Assistance Programmes; access to employee perks and Releaf staff patient benefits.

How to apply:

Our application process starts off with an informal remote meeting followed by a written test.

At Releaf, we believe that diverse teams build better businesses. We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences — and we're happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process if you need them. If you'd like to discuss this, please don't hesitate to get in touch.

jobs.title: Preparador/a de Psicotécnicos para oposiciones (FYCSE, Administración, ferroviar
jobs.excerpt: 🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy¿Preparas psicotécnicos para oposiciones como Policía, Guardia Civil, Administración o ferroviarias?
jobs.description:
🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy

¿Preparas psicotécnicos para oposiciones como Policía, Guardia Civil, Administración o ferroviarias? Colabora en remoto con Polaris x Ucademy.

🧠 Buscamos preparadores/as de Psicotécnicos para oposiciones

Los psicotécnicos son una prueba decisiva, y a menudo eliminatoria, en muchas oposiciones. No se aprueban memorizando: se aprueban entrenando, con el método, la dificultad y los tiempos adecuados para cada proceso.

Queremos construir un claustro de preparadores especializados en psicotécnicos, capaces de trabajar una base transversal de aptitudes y adaptarla después a las características de cada oposición.

🧩 Aptitudes que trabajamos

  • Razonamiento verbal

  • Razonamiento numérico

  • Razonamiento lógico y abstracto

  • Razonamiento espacial

  • Atención y percepción

  • Memoria

  • Aptitud mecánica

  • Series y matrices

  • Figuras

  • Aptitudes administrativas

🎯 Adaptadas a cada oposición

Cada proceso selectivo tiene su propia tipología de ejercicios, dificultad, tiempos y número de preguntas. Buscamos preparadores que sepan trasladar esa base común a los psicotécnicos de:

🚓 Fuerzas y Cuerpos de Seguridad

  • Policía Nacional

  • Guardia Civil

  • Policía Local

  • Mossos d'Esquadra

  • Ertzaintza

🎖️ Defensa

  • Tropa y Marinería

🏛️ Administración

  • Auxiliar Administrativo del Estado (C2)

  • Auxiliares y Administrativos de comunidades autónomas, cuando la convocatoria incluya psicotécnicos

  • Auxiliares y Administrativos de Administración Local, cuando la convocatoria incluya psicotécnicos

🛃 AEAT / Aduanas

  • Agentes del Servicio de Vigilancia Aduanera

  • Cuerpo Ejecutivo del Servicio de Vigilancia Aduanera

  • Cuerpo Superior de Vigilancia Aduanera

📮 Correos

  • Personal Operativo de Correos

🚆 Ferroviarias

  • ADIF

  • Renfe

✈️ Aeronáutica

  • Controlador/a Aéreo

🚒 Emergencias

  • Bomberos, en los procesos que incluyan pruebas psicotécnicas

⚓ Puertos y transporte público

  • Policía Portuaria, cuando el proceso incluya psicotécnicos

  • Metro, EMT y otros operadores públicos de transporte, cuando sus procesos incluyan pruebas psicotécnicas

No necesitas conocerlas todas. Valoramos especialmente que tengas experiencia preparando psicotécnicos para una o varias de estas oposiciones, sin exigirla en todas.

🌟 Quiénes somos

En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros.

Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento.

Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia. La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.

🔎 A quién buscamos

  • Preparadores/as de psicotécnicos para oposiciones, con experiencia en una o varias de las anteriores.

  • Psicólogos/as con experiencia en evaluación psicotécnica o en procesos de selección.

  • Funcionarios/as o personal con plaza que hayan superado los psicotécnicos de su oposición y sepan enseñarlos.

  • Personas capaces de explicar el método, no solo la solución: estrategias de resolución, gestión del tiempo y análisis de errores.

  • Quienes sepan adaptar la dificultad y el ritmo a cada oposición y a cada alumno.

  • Quienes sepan enseñar y acompañar: motivar, detectar bloqueos y hacer fácil lo que parece imposible.

  • Soltura con herramientas digitales. Si ya utilizas IA en tu día a día, mucho mejor.

🎯 En qué podrás colaborar

Según tu perfil y disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos:

  • Clases online por aptitudes: razonamiento, atención, memoria, series, figuras…

  • Creación de baterías de ejercicios con la tipología y dificultad de cada oposición.

  • Simulacros cronometrados con el formato, el número de preguntas y los tiempos reales.

  • Análisis de errores y estrategias de resolución por tipo de ejercicio.

  • Adaptación de materiales a nuevas convocatorias.

  • Seguimiento de alumnos, vídeos cortos y guías de trucos y métodos.

🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración

No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educativos concretos, compatible con tu actividad profesional.

Si tienes plaza, no te pedimos que dejes tu puesto. Queremos que pongas tu experiencia al servicio de otros opositores de una forma flexible.

🌍 100 % remoto
🕐 Horarios y disponibilidad a convenir
📚 Proyectos y entregables definidos desde el inicio
💰 Compensación competitiva según el proyecto y los entregables

🎬 Cómo es el proceso de selección

Queremos conocerte enseñando, no solo leyendo tu CV. El proceso tiene tres pasos:

1. Revisión de perfil. En la candidatura responderás a unas preguntas breves y nos enviarás un vídeo de presentación de 1 minuto. Grábalo con el móvil, sin complicaciones: cuéntanos quién eres, tu experiencia con psicotécnicos y para qué oposiciones los has preparado.

2. Contacto de validación. Si tu perfil encaja, nos pondremos en contacto contigo por llamada o por escrito para resolver dudas, conocer tu disponibilidad y explicarte cómo colaboramos.

3. Clase de prueba y entrevista. Agendarás tu entrevista y, antes de la fecha, nos enviarás una clase grabada de máximo 5 minutos: la resolución comentada de varios ejercicios psicotécnicos de un tipo (series, matrices, razonamiento espacial…), explicando el método para resolverlos rápido, con un material de apoyo creado por ti. Puedes grabar tu pantalla si te resulta más cómodo. No buscamos una producción perfecta: queremos ver cómo explicas y cómo haces sencillo lo difícil.

Si sabes entrenar la mente para los psicotécnicos y quieres ayudar a otros a superarlos, queremos conocerte.

jobs.title: Senior Content Engineer for Blexr
jobs.excerpt: About the CompanyBlexrBlexr is the pinnacle of lead generation in iGaming.
jobs.description:
About the Company

Blexr

Blexr is the pinnacle of lead generation in iGaming. We’re all about fostering connections that matter. Since the company’s start in 2015, we’ve been on a quest to build leading marketing products. Our story is one of many successes and a few useful failures, through which we’ve grown wiser and more resilient. And, we’ve been doing this together as a team.

We create and refine solutions that connect our users with exactly what they’re looking for. Our clients commission reviews and promotional material from us, which allows us to keep our service 100% free for our users. Even so, we ensure to keep our content honest and unbiased.

Despite our solutions and products evolving over time, our ethics remain unchanged. Trust and transparency are paramount to us. We lay things bare for our users to help them make more educated and informed decisions online.

Our Vision is to be the champion of a better game by keeping our eyes on our mission of pushing boundaries and challenging the norm. Creating brand new experiences and products that enable our users to make the most informed decisions online.

About the Role

As aSenior Content Engineer,you'll act as the editorial and technical owner of one of our flagship slots brands. You'll shape its voice, its slots content strategy, and the systems that let us produce accurate, useful, and distinctly branded content at scale.

The brand has grown through the contributions of many writers over many years. The next stage is to give it one clear, recognisable identity: a single tone of voice across every page, review, news article, and on-site communication. You'll define that voice, turn it into standards that can be applied through our proprietary AI content platform, and make sure it holds up in everything we publish.

You'll bring deep slots knowledge to the role. You'll understand what players look for when they discover, compare, and play slots, and you'll use that understanding to shape how slot pages and reviews are planned, structured, and created.

Beyond traditional pages, you'll lead "content product" initiatives that turn content into interactive, personalised experiences, such as slot tournaments, that build user loyalty, engagement, and repeat visits.

You'll also own the continuous improvement of our core automated workflows. You'll run a structured improvement loop in which performance data, quality evaluation, and user signals feed directly back into prompts, templates, data, and review processes, so that our pages keep getting better.

Reporting to the Head of SEO & Content, you'll operate as a senior individual contributor at the intersection of content, brand, SEO, product, data, and technology, turning strategic priorities into clear quarterly plans and leading complex initiatives through to measurable outcomes.

This role suits someone who sees content as both a brand and a system: recognisable, user-led, measurable, and capable of improving continuously at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Slots strategy and creation

  • Own the slots content strategy for the brand, defining which slots, providers, themes, and mechanics to cover, how to prioritise them, and how slot content should evolve with market and player trends.

  • Lead the design of how slot pages and slot reviews are created, including the structured data, content models, and editorial rules that make each page accurate, useful, and genuinely helpful to players.

  • Apply expert knowledge of slot mechanics, features, volatility, RTP, providers, and release trends to ensure content reflects what real players care about.

  • Partner with SEO and analytics specialists to decide which slot content to create, update, expand, consolidate, or retire, based on organic performance and user demand.

Brand and tone of voice

  • Define and own a single, consistent tone of voice for all content and on-site communications, bringing coherence to a large body of content produced by many contributors over time.

  • Translate that voice into practical, enforceable standards (style guides, examples, rules, and prompt components) that can be applied at scale through our proprietary AI content platform.

  • Lead the restyling of existing content so that legacy pages align with the brand voice, prioritising by traffic, commercial value, and user impact.

  • Design evaluation frameworks that measure brand alignment and voice consistency alongside factual accuracy, completeness, SEO requirements, and regulatory compliance.

Content products and brand building

  • Lead the continued development of the brand as a destination players choose, trust, and return to, rather than a site they simply land on through search.

  • Identify, design, and deliver "content product" initiatives that use content to create interactive or personalised player experiences, such as slot tournaments, tailored slot recommendations, and other features that encourage on-site interaction.

  • Work with Product, Commercial, and other stakeholders to turn user-needs insights into prioritised initiatives that prove user loyalty, engagement, and repeat visits.

  • Define success metrics for content products and use evidence to decide what to scale, iterate on, or retire.

Quarterly planning and cross-functional delivery

  • Translate brand, content and content-engineering priorities into clear quarterly plans, defining deliverables, sequencing, dependencies, owners and measures of success.

  • Coordinate delivery across Content, SEO, Product, Commercial, Data and Engineering, ensuring initiatives remain aligned with wider strategic goals.

  • Identify and manage risks, dependencies and competing priorities, making pragmatic trade-offs where needed to keep delivery on track.

  • Maintain a forward-looking view beyond immediate delivery, identifying opportunities and constraints that should influence future quarters.

Continuous improvement of automated workflows

  • Own the ongoing improvement of our core automated workflows.

  • Establish a repeatable improvement loop that connects organic performance, quality evaluation, user behaviour, and editorial feedback back into prompts, templates, data sources, and review processes.

  • Lead controlled experiments on models, prompts, templates, data sources, and workflow designs, using evidence to decide what should be adopted, improved, or retired.

  • Establish monitoring and observability for these workflows so that failures, quality degradation, voice drift, and bottlenecks are detected and resolved quickly.

  • Own the investigation of complex or recurring production issues, identifying root causes across prompts, models, data, templates, integrations, and review processes, and building durable fixes back into the system.

  • Define the right balance between automated validation and human oversight according to the complexity, sensitivity, and potential impact of each content type.

  • Optimise content systems for quality, reliability, maintainability, speed, and cost, making clear trade-offs based on business value and production risk.

Standards and leadership

  • Set the standards for AI prompting on the brand, including prompt composition, voice and style components, contextual inputs, structured outputs, versioning, testing, and release processes.

  • Provide technical and editorial leadership to Content team members, mentoring colleagues, reviewing approaches and helping them navigate complex or ambiguous problems.

  • Raise capability across the team by creating reusable approaches, sharing expertise and ensuring lessons from individual projects improve how the wider team works.

  • Act as a senior point of coordination when initiatives span multiple teams, helping resolve ambiguity, dependencies and difficult delivery decisions.

  • Maintain clear documentation, including the brand voice guide, system specifications, evaluation criteria, operating procedures, and decision records.

  • Evaluate emerging AI, automation, and content-technology capabilities, distinguishing useful opportunities from short-lived trends.

Requirements

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of online slots (mechanics, features, providers, player behaviour, and market trends) and a genuine understanding of what slots players need.

  • Proven experience defining and owning a brand tone of voice, and applying it consistently across a large, multi-author content estate.

  • Significant hands-on experience designing, building, and continuously improving AI-assisted or automated content systems at meaningful scale.

  • Experience leading content initiatives that go beyond static pages into interactive, personalised, or product-like user experiences.

  • A systems-oriented approach to content, with the ability to turn ambiguous requirements into structured inputs, reusable components, validation rules, and measurable outcomes.

  • Advanced practical experience with prompt engineering, structured generation, model evaluation, and automated quality assurance, including encoding style and voice into AI outputs.

  • Strong technical fluency with automation platforms, APIs, scripting, content management systems, structured data, and tool integrations, with the ability to prototype solutions directly.

  • Experience designing evaluation and monitoring systems that make quality, voice consistency, reliability, and performance visible at scale.

  • Strong diagnostic skills, with the ability to isolate root causes and implement solutions that prevent problems from recurring.

  • A solid understanding of SEO and how scalable content systems support sustainable organic growth.

  • Sound editorial judgement, particularly when translating expectations around accuracy, tone, compliance, and user value into automated safeguards.

  • The ability to plan and deliver across a three-to-six-month horizon, balancing immediate production needs with longer-term brand and platform improvements.

  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain complex systems and brand standards to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience guiding and influencing colleagues without formal authority, raising standards through reviews, documentation, coaching, and practical example.

Will Be a Plus

  • You have experience in the iGaming industry, particularly slots and casino, and understand the associated regulatory and compliance considerations.

  • You have led a large-scale content restyling or brand-voice consolidation project.

  • You have built engagement or loyalty features such as tournaments, personalisation, recommendations, or gamified experiences.

  • You have experience with Python, JavaScript, SQL, APIs, data-transformation tools, or workflow-orchestration platforms.

  • You have built production workflows using LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, tool-calling, structured outputs, or automated evaluation frameworks.

  • You have built dashboards or alerting systems for content quality, voice consistency, workflow reliability, or organic performance.

  • You have contributed to the development or technical direction of a proprietary AI or content-automation platform.

Financial Reporting

Standard Job Description

WHO WE ARE
At Lockheed Martin, we are passionate about innovation and integrity. We believe that by applying the highest standards of business ethics and forward-thinking, everything is within our capacity – and yours as a Lockheed Martin employee. Lockheed Martin values your skills, training, education, and background.

WHAT WE'RE DOING
Do you want to be part of an environment that encourages and supports employees to think big, perform with quality and build incredible products? We provide the resources, encouragement, and focus - if you have the resourcefulness and courage to work hard, then we want to build a better tomorrow with you. Come and experience your future!

THE WORK
This REMOTE analyst position will support Supply Chain, Operations, Operations Finance, and Programs Finance to provide material cost reporting for Marine Corps Programs, including the CH-53K program, and will be a key contributor to enhancing the overall cost reporting processes and tools.

Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
• Partner with Supply Chain to develop and align on the monthly EAC status, variance analysis and reporting, and related EAC risk and opportunities.
• Investigate, validate and document key drivers to monthly EAC changes, supported by contractual and /or financial system evidence.
• Prepare and present (in a concise and coherent manner) EAC status updates, including key drivers to EAC changes and risk and opportunity positions, at the monthly EAC Reviews with Operations and Supply Chain executive leadership.
• Evaluate and integrate impacts of Over Target Approvals and Purchase Price Variance into EAC, and support strategies that drive material cost management.
• Leverage labor hour forecasts and MRP data to support time-phased spend forecasts (i.e. TPUT) for Long Range Plan, Annual Plan, and Monthly Outlooks.
• Continually assess tools and core processes to identify data and / or process gaps; investigate and identify potential solutions to close gaps.
• Partner with Operations Finance, IT, Data Analytics teams to implement process improvements, automate reporting, tableau dashboard creation, and digital transformation initiatives that drive efficiency and financial results. Current project is the EAC Vault, designed to replace multiple legacy tools and manual spreadsheets with a single, standardized process that provides one source of truth for labor and material EACs. While the tool will modernize how EACs are developed and reviewed, it is not changing what we do — it is improving how we do it.

• Support other Operations Supply Chain initiatives, as well as other ad-hoc requests as required.

WHY JOIN US
Opportunity for Impact: Join a team that is at the forefront of innovation in the aerospace and defense industry and make a significant impact on the success of our organization.
Professional Development: Take advantage of unparalleled opportunities for growth and advancement within Lockheed Martin, with access to world-class training and development programs.
Collaborative Culture: Work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry who share your passion for excellence and who are committed to supporting each other's success.
Competitive Benefits: Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off, as well as competitive salary offerings.
Cutting-Edge Technology: Be part of a dynamic and forward-thinking work environment where you will have the opportunity to work with the latest technology and contribute to groundbreaking projects that are shaping the future of aerospace and defense.

Basic Qualifications

This role may require up to 15% travel.

• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college in a related discipline, or equivalent experience/combined education, with 6+ years of professional experience; or 4+ years of professional experience with a related Master’s degree.
• Strong business acumen with a comprehensive understanding of financial concepts, business operations and controls, and the relationship between business transactions and financial impacts / results.
• Strong systems expertise with advance knowledge of Microsoft Excel; working knowledge of SAP (CES and P1S) and Sikorsky F&BO financial tools (Hyperion, tableau, etc.).

Desired Skills

• Working knowledge of Earned Value Management
• Ability to identify and implement practical solutions to a range of complex problems that are consistent with organizational objectives.
• Strong analytical skills with ability to turn large volumes of data into clear and concise summaries and actionable results.
• Agility to execute in a dynamic cross-functional team environment with ability to build effective relationships with suppliers, customers and other stakeholders.
• Ability to exert some influence on the overall objectives and long-range goals of the organization, engage with senior personnel on significant matters.
• Solid interpersonal and strong communication skills, with ability to work independently and with a team in a fast-paced & dynamic environment.

Pay Information

    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $65200.00 - $121200.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc.

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.
